jobs.title: Faculty Support and Academic Program Coordinator, Office of Faculty Support and Academic Success Program
jobs.description:
Founded in 1896, the Gould School of Law has a distinguished past built on the principles of equity and excellence, and the courage to break new ground. USC first introduced legal education in Southern California. Today, the Law School continues to make history through its philosophy of innovation and through its people. USC Gould cultivates analytical ability, ethical values, and a spirit of collegiality that prepare students for meaningful careers benefiting society. It was one of the first law schools to engage students in clinical programs and remains a leader in experiential education.

The Gould School of Law is seeking to hire a Faculty Support Coordinator to join the Office of Faculty Support and support the Academic Success Program. This position will report to the Director of Faculty Support, and will assist a number of faculty with their research and teaching needs. The number of faculty assigned may vary throughout the year

**ATTENTION:** This position is full-time, benefits-eligible, and 1-year fixed term. Applicants must upload a cover letter and a resume to be considered for this position.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Preferred Education: Bachelor's degree in legal studies
* Preferred Experience: Experience in higher education

**Job Accountabilities:**

  

This position involves a variety of administrative tasks that include, but are not limited to, the following:

**50% Faculty Support**

  

* Directly completes work assignments from professors, including scanning and making photocopies, drafting and formatting letters of recommendation for students, proofreading and editing documents, ordering supplies, answering incoming calls and emails, managing and coordinating schedules.
* Helps prepare course materials, coordinates exams, takes class attendance, assists in the ordering of textbooks and additional resources, organizes and edits PowerPoint presentations, spreadsheets, and classroom handouts.
* Posts assignments, announcements, and readings to Brightspace, records grades, releases class recordings, and oversees other relevant course content.
* Arranges travel and parking reservations for faculty and guest speakers.
* Processes reimbursement requests for faculty travel and other university expenses.
* Sorts and sends mail, letters, and packages.
* Assists in event planning, including reserving meeting spaces, ordering catering, setting up rooms, coordinating speaking engagements for law professors, and other logistical needs.
* Lends classroom support to faculty to ensure that they know how to operate audio-visual equipment. Helps troubleshoot any IT issues.
* Files and/or transcribes legal documents.
* Will assist with both final exam administration and proctoring at the end of the Fall and Spring semesters and commencement each year.
* Perform other related duties as assigned or requested. The university reserves the right to add or change duties at any time.

**50% Academic Success Program (ASP):**

Gould’s ASP is a comprehensive program that assists JD students from admission to law school through admission to the bar. This means that ASP has programming, communications, events, and services on a 12-month schedule. The ASP is staffed by its director and associate director (both of whom are Gould faculty members), six ASP Fellows (who are upper division law students), and two Alumni Bar Coaches (who are recent Gould graduates). The program looks forward to welcoming a dedicated Faculty Support Coordinator to help with many tasks, including but not limited to those listed below. There will be other duties related to the program that are assigned or requested on an ad hoc basis and as the program changes.

The ASP Support Coordinator will also work with the faculty to create systems to make all of the ASP administrative tasks more routine and efficient, including developing ASP calendaring systems, tracking student communications, and creating instructions for how to complete required administrative tasks.

The ASP Support Coordinator will deal with students and with sensitive student data (including GPA data). As such, the ASP Support Coordinator must be highly respectful of confidentiality and privacy concerns.

It will be important for the ASP Support Coordinator to be present, on-campus dependably on at least three days per week, and on other days as needed. For example, the ASP Support Coordinator will be expected to be on campus on ASP workshop days, and during summer programs including the simulated bar exam (early July), Gould Preview (early-to-mid August), and Orientation (mid-August).

The administrative responsibilities of the ASP Support Coordinator include both those listed above under Faculty Support and the following, which is a non-exhaustive list:

  

* Creating, updating, and disseminating flyers and other publicity to promote ASP events
* Scheduling rooms and communications with other departments (often having to reschedule rooms at last minute because of double-booked events)
* Ordering and delivering food for ASP events and workshops
* Creating and administering surveys for a variety of purposes including surveys to evaluate the ASP’s events, workshops, courses, and other programs
* Updating content and posting announcements on the ASP Brightspace page
* Coordinating with ASP Fellows, alumni bar coaches, and student and alumni volunteers on events, workshops, and projects
* Outreach to other faculty to coordinate teaching schedules, reading assignments, etc. for Gould Preview and other ASP programs
* Organizing and distributing materials (e.g., homework and readings) to students through
* undefined
* Communicating with students and prospective students by email and in person, including responding to routine questions from students and alumni
* Working with Gould’s Events team on ASP events and workshops
* Updating regular and ongoing monthly (and during spring and summer, weekly) email communications for students and recent graduates

jobs.title: PR and Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**POSITION TITLE:** PR and Marketing Coordinator  
**REPORTING TO:** Director of Advancement

Non-Exempt

**GENERAL SUMMARY:** The job of PR and Marketing Coordinator was established to coordinate OCCA's marketing, digital communications, and assist with fundraising and donor relations. The Coordinator develops accurate and compelling content that increases awareness of OCCA, strengthens engagement with current and prospective families, supports enrollment and advancement priorities, and consistently reflects the school's mission and classical identity.

This position is distinguished by its schoolwide scope and its combination of creative production, relationship-building, and detailed project management. The Coordinator works across the Lower School and Upper School to gather stories, manage communications channels, protect student privacy, and translate OCCA's mission into clear messaging for families, community partners, donors, media, and the broader public. The incumbent is expected to manage routine work independently, collaborate closely with the Director of Advancement, and exercise sound judgment in a fast-paced school environment.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Communications Planning and Content Development**

* Working with the Director of Advancement, develop and maintain an annual communications and content calendar aligned with the academic year, enrollment cycle, school events, advancement initiatives, and major organizational milestones.
* Write, edit, and coordinate school communications, including newsletters, announcements, feature stories, website copy, promotional messages, and other materials for internal and external audiences.
* Partner with administrators, faculty, staff, students, and families to identify timely stories and accurately communicate OCCA's programs, achievements, needs, and community impact.
* Manage editorial workflows, approvals, deadlines, and content archives so communications are accurate, timely, coordinated, and consistent in voice.

**Social Media and Digital Engagement**

* Develop, schedule, and publish engaging content across OCCA's social media channels.
* Create and curate photographs, short-form video, graphics, captions, and testimonials that authentically show classical education and student life at OCCA.

* Review digital content regularly for accuracy, broken links, outdated information, usability, and alignment with OCCA's current programs and policies.

**Public Relations and Community Outreach**

* Draft press releases, media advisories, background materials, official statements, and other public-relations materials for leadership review and approval.
* Develop relationships with community organizations, civic partners, and local media that increase understanding of OCCA and its contribution to Orange County families.
* Coordinate volunteers as needed for events.

**Brand Management and Creative Services**

* Apply and help maintain OCCA's visual identity, voice, school colors, logo standards, and messaging across digital and print communications.

* Maintain organized libraries of approved logos, templates, photographs, video, testimonials, and other communications assets.

* Support marketing for school tours, information sessions, open houses, community events, and other activities that introduce prospective families to OCCA.
* Collaborate with the Director of Advancement on donor communications, fundraising campaigns, sponsorship materials, and event promotion while maintaining appropriate school and Foundation distinctions.

* Assist with volunteer coordination as needed for events.

* Support the planning, promotion, and execution of school fundraising campaigns, appeals, sponsorships, and events.
* Use the donor CRM for routine data entry, tracking, list preparation, and basic reporting while maintaining accurate and confidential records.

**Part-Time | Growth-Oriented | Hybrid**

**Location:** Orange County, CA (Hybrid: Remote + In-Person Support)

**Schedule:** Approximately 20 hours per week to start, with growth potential

**Compensation:** Competitive hourly rate based on experience

About Life Simplified by Shannon

Life Simplified by Shannon is a growing luxury home organization company based in Orange County, California. We help busy individuals and families create beautiful, functional, and thoughtfully organized spaces that simplify everyday life.

Our work is built on exceptional service, attention to detail, and a genuine commitment to making life easier for our clients.

As our company continues to grow, we’re strengthening the internal systems, processes, and support that allow our team to operate efficiently and deliver exceptional results.

**Our Core Values**

* **Communication:** Clear, thoughtful, and timely communication.
* **Efficiency:** Organized systems, smart processes, and effective execution.
* **Enthusiasm:** Positive energy, initiative, and pride in our work.
* **Attention to Detail:** Recognizing that small details make a big difference.
* **Integrity:** Taking ownership, following through, and doing what we say we’ll do.

This role is focused on **behind-the-scenes organization and executive support**, rather than client communication or client relationship management.

You’ll be responsible for keeping Shannon’s schedule and priorities organized, maintaining accurate administrative and financial records, supporting employee and contractor onboarding, and ensuring important internal tasks are completed efficiently.

You’ll work alongside our existing operations team, helping maintain the systems and processes that keep the business running smoothly.

We’re looking for someone who can work independently, anticipate needs, solve problems, and confidently take ownership of responsibilities without constant oversight.

**The ideal candidate doesn’t just complete tasks. They identify what needs to happen next, find solutions, and make sure things get done.**

Provide dependable, proactive support that helps Shannon stay organized, focused, and productive.

* Help manage competing priorities and keep important projects moving forward.
* Anticipate needs and handle administrative details before they become urgent.
* Protect Shannon’s time by taking ownership of delegated tasks and ensuring consistent follow-through.

**2. Bookkeeping Administration & Financial Tracking**

Maintain organized and accurate financial records to support day-to-day business operations.

* Track employee and contractor hours and accurately allocate time to the appropriate client projects.
* Maintain internal client inventory records, including products purchased, used, returned, and outstanding.
* Collect, organize, and categorize receipts, purchases, and business expenses.
* Support bookkeeping administration and expense tracking using QuickBooks or other internal systems.
* Track and follow up on vendor refunds, returns, credits, and outstanding disputes.

* Identify missing receipts, discrepancies, or incomplete financial information.

* Assist with internal financial reports and administrative summaries as needed.

*This position focuses on bookkeeping support, financial organization, and accurate recordkeeping rather than advanced accounting or financial management.*

* Keep internal records, digital documents, financial files, and shared folders organized and up to date.
* Assist in creating and documenting standard operating procedures (SOPs), checklists, and internal workflows.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce repetitive tasks, and streamline administrative processes.

* Research and troubleshoot software, subscriptions, and business tools.

jobs.description:
Inside Sales Representative (Custom Builds)

**The Simple Luxe Builds | Norwalk, CA**  
**Full-time | In-person | Salary + performance bonus**

About The Simple Luxe

The Simple Luxe is a creative services company with two thriving divisions: **Events** and **Builds**. Our tagline says it all: *“we make simple, simply luxurious.”* We transform ordinary gatherings into extraordinary experiences through custom fabrication, event design, and premium installations.

Our Builds division creates **brand activations**, **trade show booths**, **custom furniture**, and **specialty fabrication** for clients nationwide, with a strong base in Los Angeles and Orange County.

Role Overview

We’re hiring a full-time **Inside Sales Representative** to manage a high volume of inbound inquiries while also supporting outbound relationship-building that drives long-term growth. You’ll own the sales process from first response through close, working closely with engineering/design and the shop team to scope projects, create proposals, and win orders.

This role is **salary + quarterly performance bonuses**.

What You’ll Sell

* Brand activations / experiential builds
* Trade show booths and exhibit builds (including installations)
* Custom furniture builds for the event rental industry (bars, backbars, tables, display units, and specialty builds)
* Custom backdrops (collapsible and non-collapsible) and specialty installations

Primary Responsibilities

Sales Development & Revenue Generation

* Respond quickly to inbound inquiries, qualify opportunities, and move deals forward
* Proactively identify and outreach to target accounts (agencies, exhibit houses, event rental groups, brand teams)
* Build and maintain a robust pipeline across Los Angeles/Orange County and select nationwide opportunities
* Run discovery calls and client meetings to confirm scope, budget, timeline, and success criteria
* Create proposals, quotes, and pitch materials tailored to each project
* Present solutions and close deals with a consultative, professional approach
* Attend networking events and industry functions to generate leads

Technical Consultation & Client Management

* Conduct site assessments and technical consultations to understand client needs
* Coordinate with engineering/design to support **3D model development** for client presentations
* Collaborate with design/fabrication teams to ensure client specifications are met
* Provide accurate quotes based on materials, labor, customization, and shipping requirements
* Ensure clean handoff from sales to production (scope clarity, change orders, timelines)

Market Development

* Research and identify high-potential industries and clients (event rental, trade shows, brand activations)
* Build relationships with event planners, rental companies, agencies, and corporate event coordinators
* Develop strategic partnerships with complementary service providers

Qualifications

Experience & Skills

* **3–5 years of B2B sales experience** (events, fabrication, manufacturing, construction, experiential, or related industries strongly preferred)
* Proven ability to manage inbound leads and close custom project work
* Strong written and verbal communication (you’ll be creating proposals and presenting to clients)
* Strong presentation and negotiation skills
* Technical aptitude with the ability to understand fabrication processes, materials, and custom builds
* Organized pipeline management and reliable follow-through

Tools & Technical Requirements

* Proficiency with CRM systems and project management tools (**Monday.com experience a plus**)
* Comfortable with Instagram, email, and multi-channel communication
* Ability to read technical drawings and understand fabrication specifications (preferred)
* Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel locally for client meetings/networking

Personal Attributes

* Highly driven and self-motivated with an entrepreneurial mindset
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, growing small business environment
* Detail-oriented with strong organizational and time management abilities

Compensation

* **Base salary: $75,000–$90,000 (DOE)**
* **Performance bonus:** paid quarterly, with an annual reconciliation based on full-year results

Location & Schedule

* **In-person role based in Norwalk, CA** (Los Angeles/Orange County area)

Additional Requirements

* A signed Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) is required as a condition of employment

jobs.title: Trade Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Salary Range:** **$26.00 - $28.00/ Hourly**

SUMMARY: This role provides coordination and administrative support to the trade marketing team, serving as the central coordinator for all trade marketing plans managed by Marketing. Positioned between the marketing and sales functions, the Trade Marketing Coordinator manages trade plan requests in Asana, tracks and reconciles invoices against approved plans, and ensures marketing collateral and deliverables reach the sales team on time. Working closely with marketing and sales team members, this role helps integrate trade and direct marketing plans so both teams stay aligned, informed, and on schedule.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

* Serve as the coordinator for all trade marketing plans managed by the Marketing team, maintaining plan details, timelines, budgets, and deliverables in a central, up-to-date view.
* Support incoming Asana requests related to trade plans, helping confirm briefs are complete, due dates are clear, and tasks reach the appropriate team members.
* Track and compare trade partner and vendor invoices against approved trade plans, flagging discrepancies, overages, or undelivered items and following up with stakeholders to resolve them.
* Ensure marketing collateral and deliverables are shared with the sales team on time, coordinating deadlines and communicating updates or changes as they arise.
* Support the integration of trade and direct marketing plans, helping align timing, offers, and messaging across channels so the two plans work together.
* Review trade and sales-facing marketing materials, including approach guides, the travel advisor portal, and sales and consortia materials, flagging outdated, inaccurate, or off-brand content for the appropriate owners and making minor corrections where appropriate.
* Act as a day-to-day liaison between Marketing and Sales on trade plan status, questions, and requested updates, tracking them through to completion.
* Support trade shows, sales events, and partner programs as needed, including logistics, materials, vendor communication, and attendee coordination.
* Prepare status reports, trackers, and meeting notes to provide visibility into trade plan progress, planned versus actual spend, and team priorities.
* Maintain project documentation, workflows, templates, and process guides to support consistent trade plan management across Marketing and Sales.
* Provide general administrative support to the Marketing team as needed.
* Perform other related duties as assigned by management.

COMPETENCIES: To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the

following competencies:

* Planning/Organizing - Prioritizes and plans work activities; Uses time efficiently; Plans for additional resources; Sets goals and objectives; Organizes or schedules other people and their tasks; Develops realistic action plans.
* Quality Management - Looks for ways to improve and promote quality; Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness.
* Dependability - Follows instructions, responds to management direction; Takes responsibility for own actions; Keeps commitments; Commits to long hours of work when necessary to reach goals; Completes tasks on time or notifies appropriate person with an alternate plan.
* Project Management - Develops project plans; Coordinates projects; Communicates changes and progress; Completes projects on time and budget; Manages project team activities.
* Written Communication - Writes clearly and informatively; Edits work for spelling and grammar; Varies writing style to meet needs; Presents numerical data effectively; Able to read and interpret written information.
* Cost Consciousness - Works within approved budget; Develops and implements cost saving measures; Contributes to profits and revenue; Conserves organizational resources.
* Teamwork - Balances team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit; Puts success of team above own interests; Able to build morale and group commitments to goals and objectives; Supports everyone's efforts to succeed.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS: The physical demands described here are representative of those that

must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform

essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to walk, stoop,

kneel, crouch or crawl. The employee is frequently required to stand, reach with hands and arms. The employee is continually required to sit, use hands to finger, handle or feel; talk or hear.

The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 45 pounds.

Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and color vision.

WORK ENVIRONMENT: The work environment characteristics described here are

representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this

job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform

jobs.title: Major Accounts Associate Sales Representative - Mid-Market
jobs.description:
ADP is hiring an **Associate Sales Representative, Mid-Sized Accounts.**

  

* Are you ready to control your financial future with unlimited upside earnings potential?
* Do you want a lasting career with a company that offers autonomy to run a book of business, flexibility to

make your own schedule, and gives you work-life balance?
  

* Are you looking for continuous learning and the opportunity to invest in yourself?

If so, then this may be just the opportunity you've been searching for. Read on and decide for yourself.
  
In this role, you will learn ADP’s market-leading suite of HCM technology and services while working alongside
  
tenured associates. This role is designed to shorten your learning curve and ramp up time to success by putting you
  
in a position to work independently and collaboratively across all facets of our mid-market business and across
  
functional area experts. You will learn how to sell human resources technology within a designated geographic
  
territory to cultivate new business opportunities and drive strategic discussions around Human Capital
  
Management (HCM) initiatives for companies with 150 – 500 employees. You will co-manage complete sales
  
cycles, sell ADP's suite of solutions (40+ products and services) to executives, and accurately forecast your sales
  
pipeline. ADP is here to support you and your goals with continuous sales training and the latest technology to set
  
you up for success as you manage your book of business.

You'll spend most of your time doing what you do best – selling in the field. But that's not all. You'll also document
  
and manage multiple sales cycles, sticking with the process through implementation until your new business is up
  
and running on the solutions you sell. As you see more and more deals cross the finish line, you'll reap the rewards
  
with industry-leading compensation, benefits, luxurious incentive trips, and awards. You will be armed not only
  
with the most robust technology stack in the industry but also industry-leading and AI-driven sales tools that will
  
help you in all facets of your selling cycle management from research to close. As you strive to grow your career,
  
leaders will back your desire to pursue advancement and provide continual sales training.
  
  
Ready to #MakeYourMark? Apply now!
  
To learn more about Sales at ADP, visit https://jobs.adp.com/teams-roles/sales/

**WHAT YOU'LL DO: Responsibilities**
  
**Grow Our Business While Growing Yours.** You will work independently and collaboratively as part of
  
various teams within your assigned geography to close sales, win business, and reach sales goals.
  
**Turn Prospects into Loyal Clients and Raving Fans.** You will implement a sales strategy targeted to
  
decision-makers and business owners to build a network and capture new business.
  
**Deepen Relationships Across the ADP Family.** In addition to selling cloud-based human resources
  
solutions, you will strategically cultivate additional business within existing accounts. But it's not all
  
business; you will make life-long friendships here.
  
**Collaborate Daily.** You will serve as a trusted advisor, partner, and ADP ambassador to your clients,
  
internal partners, and overall network while demonstrating grace under pressure and the highest ethical
  
standards.

  

**TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE: Required Qualifications**  

* Proven Winner. You have an impressive track record of closing sales, winning clients, and managing a

territory.
  

* Positive Self-Starter. You have an upbeat, persistent style and the ability to cold call, manage your time

well, and can present your ideas in a clear professional manner on paper, in-person, and over the phone.
  

* Confidently Fearless. You embrace opportunities, take risks, and challenge the status quo.
* Entrepreneurial Spirit. You're a natural leader, resourceful, thrive under pressure, and bounce back quickly.
* Trusted Advisor. You build relationships, live integrity, and deliver on promises…every time.

A college degree is great but not required. What's more important is having the skills to do the job. If you don't
  
have a college degree, other acceptable experience could include:
  

* Two+ years of quota-carrying, outside business-to-business sales experience
* Three+ years of relevant experience in HCM, technology, business equipment, uniform, or software sales
* Prior military experience that focused on teamwork, resilience, negotiation, trust-building, and a "never

lose" mentality earned as part of the military to build relationships, impact businesses for the better, and
  
achieve success.

**BONUS POINTS FOR THESE: Preferred Qualifications**
  

* Ability to successfully build a network and effectively use social media for sales

  

**YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:**
  

* Be yourself in a culture that values equity, inclusion, and belonging and creates a safe space for diverse

perspectives and insights.
  

* Belong by joining one of nine Business Resource Groups where you can connect globally with networks and

allies who share common interests and experiences.
  

* Grow your career in an agile, fast-paced environment means plenty of opportunities to progress.
* Continuously learn. Ongoing training, development, and mentorship opportunities for even the most

insatiable learner.
  

* Be your healthiest. Best-in-class benefits start on Day 1 because healthy associates are happy ones.
* Balance work and life. Resources and flexibility to more easily integrate your work and your life.
* Focus on your mental health and well-being. We're here to provide exceptional service to our clients, and

none of that happens without each of us taking care of ourselves and being there for one another.
  

* Join a company committed to giving back and generating a lasting, positive impact upon the communities

in which we work and live.
  

* Get paid to pay it forward. Company-paid time off for vo

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Account Manager

GSG Protective Services is seeking an experienced and professional **Operations Support Specialist** to support security operations, personnel management, client relations, scheduling oversight, and training functions across designated assignments.

This leadership role is responsible for ensuring operational excellence, regulatory compliance, client satisfaction, and effective supervision of security personnel.

**Essential Duties & Key Responsibilities**

* Manage physical security procedures and operational protocols.
* Supervise security officers and operational personnel.
* Respond to incidents and complete documentation and reporting.
* Train personnel on company policies and post orders.
* Develop and maintain employee schedules.
* Conduct scheduling and payroll audits.
* Promote a positive and professional work environment.
* Collaborate with clients and internal leadership.
* Effectively resolve operational concerns and de-escalate situations professionally.
* Perform additional duties as assigned.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Associate degree or higher required.
* Minimum three (3) years of related security or operations experience.
* Minimum two (2) years of supervisory experience within the security industry.
* Scheduling experience managing large staffing hours preferred.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Proficient in computer systems and smartphone applications.
* Valid driver’s license with acceptable driving record in accordance with company policy.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States.
* Ability to maintain required security registrations and certifications.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher.
* Five (5) years or more of security, operations, or related industry experience.
* Client-facing management experience preferred.

**Skills, Knowledge & Abilities**

* Strong operational decision-making and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to remain composed and effective in high-pressure or time-sensitive situations.
* Excellent communication and report-writing skills.
* High level of situational awareness and professionalism.
* Ability to interact respectfully with individuals at all organizational levels.
* Ability to effectively supervise personnel and manage field operations.

**Physical Requirements**

The physical demands described here are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

* Ability to use hands and arms for reaching, handling, and grasping.
* Physically capable of assisting others in emergency situations.
* Ability to stand or walk for extended periods, including entire shifts.

**Additional Requirements**

* Must meet minimum age requirements in accordance with applicable licensing, insurance, and company policies.
* Maintain valid registration as a security guard throughout employment.
* Maintain a valid driver’s license in good standing.
* Ability to work flexible schedules and respond to operational needs outside normal business hours when required

jobs.title: Account Manager (Inside Sales)
jobs.description:
**About Chefmaster**

Chefmaster is a trusted leader in professional-quality food coloring, decorating and culinary products, serving distributors, retailers, bakeries, foodservice suppliers and home bakers. With more than 90 years behind us, we are passionate about empowering creativity in the kitchen. As we grow our customer relationships, we are looking for a proactive, results-driven Account Manager to join our team at our Fullerton, CA headquarters.

**Position Overview**

The Account Manager owns a portfolio of smaller, high-touch customer accounts, grows sales with them, and opens new accounts through warm and cold outreach. While a Customer Service Representative responds to what the customer asks for, the Account Manager anticipates what the customer needs. The ideal candidate knows each account's business, spots gaps in its product line, brings forward new products and programs, and works across departments so problems get fixed at the root instead of just closed. This role is based on-site at our Fullerton, CA headquarters.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Account Relationship Ownership**

* Serve as the main point of contact for an assigned group of smaller, high-touch accounts that need frequent, hands-on attention: distributors, retailers, and bakery and foodservice suppliers.
* Build relationships with several people at each account, including buyers, category managers, owners and operations contacts.
* Develop and maintain an account plan for top accounts covering products carried, purchase history, goals and growth opportunities.
* Help systemize how we manage customer accounts: select and roll out a CRM platform, organize account, contact and pipeline data, and train Sales and Customer Service on the new process.
* Keep complete, up-to-date account records, contacts and activity notes.

**Account Growth & Outbound Selling**

* Analyze each account's sales and product mix to find gaps: items, colors, sizes or categories it doesn't carry but should.
* Contact accounts proactively to introduce new products, line extensions, seasonal and holiday programs, promotions and displays.
* Recommend product mix changes backed by sell-through data, category trends and results from similar accounts.
* Prepare quotes, proposals and program offers, and negotiate terms within approved guidelines with support from Finance.
* Spot at-risk or declining accounts early and build a plan to win them back.
* Meet or exceed annual revenue and growth targets for assigned accounts.

**New Business Development**

* Prospect for and cold-call new distributors, retailers, bakeries and foodservice suppliers.
* Follow up on warm leads from trade shows, the website, referrals and brokers.
* Qualify prospects, open new accounts and manage their first orders before bringing them into your account portfolio.
* Build and manage a pipeline of new business against targets.

**Cross-Functional Problem Solving**

* Own customer issues from first report through resolution and follow-up, rather than handing them off.
* Work directly with Operations, Warehouse and Shipping, Quality, Accounting and Credit, Marketing and Product Development to resolve problems and keep them from recurring.
* Spot recurring issues (backorders, shipping errors, label or packaging problems) and recommend process fixes to the responsible department.
* Bring customer feedback, product requests and competitor information back to Marketing and Product Development.
* Partner with Marketing on account-specific promotions, sales materials and launch support.

**Customer Service Escalation & Support**

* Handle complex or sensitive account issues escalated by Customer Service Representatives.
* Work with Finance on order, pricing, credit and return questions that call for judgment or knowledge of the account's history.
* Coordinate large orders, first orders of new items and program orders so they arrive on time and correct.
* Share product and account knowledge with Customer Service so the team can serve assigned accounts well.

**Forecasting & Reporting**

* Provide sales forecasts by account to support inventory and production planning, especially for new items and seasonal programs.
* Track and report on account performance, upcoming opportunities and progress against targets.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Attend trade shows as needed.
* Help onboard accounts handed over from outside sales or brokers.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3–5 years in inside sales, account management or senior customer service.
* Comfortable with high-volume outbound calling, including cold calls, and with handling rejection.
* Consultative selling skills: asks good questions, builds a recommendation and makes the case for it.
* Earns customers' trust and is seen as a partner, not an order taker.
* Strong analytical skills, using sales and product mix data to find opportunities.
* Takes ownership and follows problems through to resolution across departments.
* Clear, professional written and spoken communication, including presenting to buyers.
* Organized: manages a set of accounts and priorities without close supervision.
* Willing to learn the product line in depth, including technical and how-to-use questions.
* Meets the technical skill requirements listed below.

**Preferred Qualifications**

The following are not required but will be viewed favorably:

* Experience in consumer products, food ingredients or foodservice.
* Experience working with distributors or with wholesale or retail buyers.
* Familiarity with the baking, cake decorating or specialty food channel.

**Technical Skills**

This role requires strong Excel and solid Word skills from day one. Please be specific about your skill level and the systems you have used.

* **Microsoft Excel:** Work with large sales data exports: pivot tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS/COUNTIFS, IF logic, sorting, filtering and conditional formatting. Build account-level sa

jobs.title: Affordable Housing Community Manager
jobs.description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

Asset Living is a third-party management firm and a proven partner in fostering thriving communities nationwide. Founded in 1986, Asset Living has decades of experience delivering exceptional value to our partners. Since the beginning, our undeniable passion has driven our organic growth from a small property management firm to one of the most trusted allies in real estate. Asset Living's growing portfolio includes a multitude of properties across the country that span the multifamily, single-family home rentals, affordable housing, build-to-rent, active adult, and student housing divisions.

  

Asset Living is a fast-growing company made up of talented individuals from diverse backgrounds that differentiate us and help us drive innovation and results for our clients and communities across the US. At Asset Living, we wholeheartedly believe 'Together We Lead, Together We Succeed’. We empower each other to lead by example, collaborate, and evolve – inspired by our belief that we can continually improve as individuals and as an organization. Together, we create an environment where every voice is heard, every idea is valued, and every individual experiences opportunities to grow as our company grows. When you join Asset Living, you become part of a dynamic team that thrives on unity, unique talents, and a universal culture of winning.

  

Recognized as one of the nation's Best and Brightest Places to Work and ranked in the NMHC top 50 professionals, join Asset Living because of its reputation as the most trusted partner in real estate, workplace culture, and growth opportunities. Asset Living is a member of The Institute of Real Estate Management (IREM) and is recognized as an Accredited Management Organization (AMO). Together, we lead the way, and together, we achieve excellence in all that we do. Join a workplace where success is a collective journey and leadership is a shared responsibility.

**COMMUNITY MANAGER**

The Community Manager is responsible for overseeing the entire operations of a housing community under the supervision of the Regional Manager. As a Community Manager, you will manage all phases of the operations, including personnel, leasing, maintenance, financial, administration & risk management. As an on-site leader, you will supervise all aspects of the property and staff to ensure compliance with Asset’s policies and procedures, safety and fair housing guidelines, and liability concerns.

As a leading affordable housing management company, we prefer the following experience in addition to the Essential Duties and Responsibilities outlined below for our affordable assets :

* *Minimum of 2 years' experience with affordable housing programs, including but not limited to : LIHTC, HUD (Project Based Section 8, Section 236, PRAC, 811 PRA, USDA - Rural Development (515), HCD, HOME Funds and Bonds)*
* *Affordable Housing Accreditation (HCCP, HCP-E, COS, BOS, TCS, CPO) or other applicable designations in affordable programs is preferred but not required.*

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* Personnel Management
* Regular/daily onsite attendance is required
* Use consistent techniques & company directives to screen, hire, train, coach, and develop on-site staff
* Ensure the effectiveness of staff through ongoing training, coaching, counseling, and guidance in compliance with Asset training benchmarks.
* Complete weekly/daily office & maintenance staff schedules and assignments
* Deal effectively and consistently with performance problems; document adequately, communicate with direct supervisor and HR, and terminate appropriately when necessary.
* Promote harmony and quality job performance of staff through support and effective leadership
* Ensure staff compliance and consistency with Company policies and procedures
* Financial Management
* Achieve the highest possible net operating income through the implementation of effective cost control and revenue & leasing improvement; identify trends and recommend strategies and adjustments
* Develop yearly operating budgets/forecasts
* Monitor the timely receipt and reconciliation of deposits, rent collections, and charges to ensure they are submitted on a timely basis.
* Monitor the timely receipt, reconciliation, and coding of all vendor invoices
* Ensure property closeout is completed on time and ownership financial reports are accurate

jobs.description:
Pressed Juicery is growing! Join our purpose-driven community and help us make an impact.
  
  
About Pressed Juicery
  
  
Pressed Juicery is a modern wellness brand built with the mission to empower your wellness journey.
  
  
Founded in 2010 by three friends, Pressed began as a small space with a big idea: real, nourishing food should be accessible and fit into everyday life. Pressed Juicery’s mission is to empower your wellness journey.

* We embrace diversity, equity, inclusion, and belongingness!

* We wholeheartedly support personal and professional growth.
* We believe mistakes can be valuable and lead to continuous improvement.
* Lastly, we value excellence and strive to achieve greatness in all we do!

* Community - as leaders, we celebrate differences, champion strengths, and compassionately aspire to be our most vibrant selves.

The Executive Assistant reports to the Chief Sales Officer (CSO) and provides dedicated support to both the CSO and the Chief Marketing Officer (CMO). Pressed is an ever-changing, evolving organization, and this role will evolve with it!

* Handle sensitive company, personnel, and strategic information with absolute confidentiality.

As a ***Project Coordinator*** at Schuff Steel, You will assist in managing the flow of technical information between the Schuff Steel Project Management team, customers, and subcontractors and vendors, while developing critical relationships with internal and external clients, through verbal and written communication. They collaborate with other departments to ensure all aspects of each project are executed smoothly. Schuff PC’s have worked on some of the most amazing building structures in North America. Please consider joining our dynamic Project Management Team.

**Job Overview**

* Reviews design drawings for accuracy and completeness, and coordinates resolution of discrepancies and/or missing information with customers, design team, other trades, detailing, shop, & field as may be necessary.
* Coordinates project sequencing and basic detailing job setup, including advance bills and shop and erection drawings.
* Provides technical instructions and guidance to steel detailers in preparing shop drawings per project requirements and standards.
* Monitors project schedules regarding submittals, approvals, and shop fabrication releases. Identify and communicate possible delays or problems to project management team.
* Organize detailing RFI process through formal RFI to customer and informal RFI’s with the engineer, architect, and general contractor. Facilitates and fulfills other documentation efforts and duties and as may be required.
* Distribute and route drawings. Partner with Document Control to avoid delays and maintain logs.

* Assists the Project Management Team in achieving successful project results.
* Coordinates the detailing efforts of various common subcontractors.
* Serve as a direct link between Detailers, Project Managers, and other production departments, and customer, other contractors, and Design Team as may be required.

**Education/Training**

* High School Diploma or GED required.
* Associates degree or training from an approved and accredited technical school in engineering or detailing/drafting is highly preferred.
* A Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university in CM, Structural/Civil Engineering, or other technical area may substitute for required experience.

**Work Experience**

* At least five (5) years related experience in the coordination of structural steel projects. Detailing experience highly preferred.

**Specialized Knowledge**

* Ability to read and interpret shop and design drawings.
* General understanding and knowledge of basic drafting skills
* 3D modeling software/Tekla practices, fabrication and erection standards, standard technical terminology, common structural steel practices, and drafting room procedures.

**Software & Technology**

  

* MS Windows 10, MS Office 365; Office Word, Excel, and Outlook; Contract Manager, Primavera Scheduling, Fabtrol and Tekla system. Bluebeam applications.

**Work Environment**

* The position may require frequent air/road travel as needed and required. A clean driving record will be required due to required road travel.

* This position is generally indoors in a climate-controlled office. However, frequent visitations to the outdoor plant facilities and project sites may be required.
* Reasonable accommodations will be made upon request for those who have disabilities that qualify under the American with Disabilities Act.

We believe employees should have great working conditions along with opportunities to grow and develop. We proudly promote a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone has a chance to be successful. Schuff Steel is an Equal Opportunity Employer with an Affirmative Action Plan. We value Diversity.

jobs.description:
**1. Position Overview**

The Mobile Business Unit supports the global distribution of Samsung mobile devices with a focus on speed, reliability, and operational efficiency. The Logistics Coordinator (Air & Ocean Operations) is responsible for planning, executing, and continuously improving inbound and outbound air and ocean freight operations, ensuring shipments move efficiently from manufacturers to Samsung warehouses and ultimately to customers.

This position requires hands-on experience in Air or Ocean Freight Operations, along with solid ocean freight knowledge. As our operation supports global transportation across multiple time zones, this position follows a five-day work schedule that includes weekend shifts based on operational requirements.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

1) Planning & Scheduling

* Create and maintain daily tracking reports for Air Export, Ocean Import and OTR including weekend operations

2) Port & Terminal Coordination

* Gather departure information for containers and air cargo at ports, terminals, and airports.
* Monitor and confirm on-time departures from U.S. Ocean terminals and major airports.
* Coordinate terminal departure schedules with terminal operators and customs brokers.

3) Movement Monitoring

* Track ocean containers, rail intermodal units, and air shipments in real time.
* Validate Import of Documentation (IOD) and Proof of Delivery (POD) on a daily basis.
* Respond promptly to shipment exceptions requiring immediate attention (e.g., delays, damages, customs hold).

4) Transload Warehouse Management

* Oversee Transload Warehouse (TW) capacity planning and utilization.
* Manage Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for transload operations (e.g., dwell time, on-time transload, damage rate).
* Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks and work with warehouse teams to implement corrective actions.

5) TL OB OTR Dispatch Management

* Schedule and dispatch Truckload (TL) Outbound (OB) orders using the Transportation Management System (TMS).
* Optimize routing and load consolidation to meet service-level agreements while minimizing transportation costs.

6) Partner & Stakeholder Communication

* Serve as the primary point of contact for logistics partners, including carriers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, internal supply chain teams, and customers.
* Handle claims, documentation, and issue escalations through phone, email, or virtual meetings.

7) Compliance & Documentation

* Ensure all shipments comply with international trade regulations, hazardous material requirements, and security standards.
* Maintain accurate records for audits and regulatory inspections.
* Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

8) Core Competencies

* Analytical Thinking: Translate large data sets into actionable insights.
* Problem Solving: Quickly identify root causes of operational issues and implement effective solutions.
* Communication: Communicate clearly and effectively with internal teams and external partners.
* Multitasking: Manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
* Ability to Work Under Pressure: Perform effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

**3. Requirements (Basic Qualifications)**

1) Education

* Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.

2) Experience

* Staff : Minimum 2 years of experience in logistics coordination, with a strong focus on international air and ocean freight operations.
* Senior :Minimum 6 years of experience in logistics coordination, with a strong focus on international air and ocean freight operations.
* Hands-on experience in international Air, Ocean, and OTR freight forwarding operations is required
* Proven experience managing transload warehouse operations and Truckload (TL) dispatch.

3) Industry Knowledge

* Strong understanding of international air and ocean freight regulations, and customs procedures

4) Technical Skills

* Proficiency with ERP and logistics systems (SAP, TMS, WMS or equivalent).
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP.

5) Language

* English

6) Weekend work may be required.

Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; paid sick leave; life, accidental death & dismemberment (AD&D), and long-term disability (LTD) insurance; and optional voluntary life/AD&D coverage. Benefits are subject to eligibility and applicable plan terms.

jobs.description:
**SALARY RANGE**

$82,000 to $87,000 Annually

**GENERAL DESCRIPTION**

The Facilities Project Coordinator supports the day-to-day operations of the Building Operations department through coordination of facilities requests, work orders, vendor activities, preventive maintenance workflows, and operational administration. The position serves as a central point of coordination and follow-through, helping ensure facilities activities are organized, tracked, communicated, and completed in a timely and consistent manner.

Working under the supervision of the Senior Project Manager, the Facilities Project Coordinator operates with initiative and appropriate autonomy to manage routine workflows, resolve issues within established procedures, and escalate matters requiring technical, budgetary, compliance, or leadership decisions.

This position supports strategic facility initiatives of the organization anticipated to occur over a two-year period. It is anticipated that employment in this position will continue through approximately fall 2028. The Facilities Project Coordinator role is an at-will position; length of employment will be determined based on project completion dates and schedules.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Work Order & Issue Management**

* Support the coordination of facilities requests alongside Facilities Operations team, ensuring each issue is logged, prioritized, assigned, communicated, and closed with documented follow-through.
* Administer the Angus work order system, including ticket review, assignment coordination, status tracking, reporting, user support, and workflow maintenance.
* Monitor open, overdue, recurring, and unresolved service requests; follow up proactively and escalate safety concerns, delays, or items requiring technical, budgetary, compliance, or leadership decisions.
* Assist the Facilities Operations Manager with scheduling vendors for planned maintenance, urgent service needs, and unplanned repairs.
* Coordinate work orders, vendor activity, preventive maintenance, and corrective actions through completion, confirming that required documentation and closeout information are recorded.
* Communicate service impacts, access needs, project updates, and work status to staff, vendors, and other stakeholders.

**Facility Inspections & Follow-Through**

* Coordinate quarterly facility walkthroughs with preschool site directors, document identified needs, submit work orders, and track completion.
* Coordinate quarterly inspections across all sites with Facilities and Program Support teams, document findings, open and assign work orders, and follow through on corrective actions.

**Tracking, Documentation & Administration**

* Maintain facilities project and request trackers by logging new requests, updating priorities and status, and monitoring work from initiation through completion.
* Maintain organized shared drives so project documentation, communications, vendor records, and closeout materials are current and easy to retrieve.
* Manage routine facilities administration, including vendor records, invoice routing, purchasing support, reporting, and recordkeeping.

**Project & Operational Support**

* Assist with facilities and IT project coordination tasks, including scheduling, documentation, access coordination, status tracking, and follow-up for project managers.
* Coordinate contractor access and support operational readiness activities related to scheduled facilities work.
* Provide coverage for the Facilities Operations Manager during absences to maintain continuity of routine facilities workflows and issue escalation.
* Support facilities, compliance, process-improvement, and special projects as assigned, including documentation and workflow updates.

**REQUIREMENTS**

* Associate or bachelor’s degree, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Two or more years of experience in facilities coordination, workplace operations, office administration, property management, hospitality, or a similar operational support role.
* Experience coordinating maintenance requests, vendors, contractors, or service providers in a complex or high-volume environment.
* Experience using ticketing, work order, or maintenance management systems; Angus experience preferred.
* Highly meticulous with strong file management and record-keeping habits that hold up under a high volume of concurrent work.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, take initiative, prioritize competing demands, and follow work through completion with limited supervision.
* Ability to process information and communicate clearly and concisely.
* Strong organizational, administrative, communication, and customer Service skills.
* Experience supporting purchasing, invoicing, vendor administration, or operational recordkeeping.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, particularly Teams, SharePoint, and Lists.

**WORKING CONDITIONS**  
This position is primarily performed on-site at JCCSF facilities and includes work in office, program, storage, mechanical, and other operational spaces. Occasional remote work may be considered when appropriate for specific tasks and operational requirements.

The position requires regular movement throughout the facility and frequent interaction with staff, vendors, contractors, and members of the Building Operations team. The employee may occasionally encounter noise, dust, active maintenance work, mechanical equipment, and areas with varying temperatures.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**  
Duties include regular walking throughout the facility, standing, sitting, using stairs, accessing storage and operational areas, and performing physical tasks consistent with a facilities coordination position.

The employee must be able to lift and carry items weighing up to twenty pounds. Reasonable accommodation may be provided as appropriate.

**STATUS:** Benefited, non-exempt

**HOURS:** 40 hours per week

**SCHEDULE:** Monday - Friday, general business

* Help improve administrative workflows, project tracking processes, and internal communication.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace, particularly spreadsheets.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, tasks, and deadlines simultaneously.

* Ability to work independently, take initiative, and proactively follow up on outstanding tasks.
* Professional customer service skills and ability to communicate with different team members.

**Preferred**

**Nature of Position**
----------------------

**THE POSITION**

The City of Alameda is seeking to fill a **Program Specialist II** position **to administer the City's Clean Water Program activities.** Under direction, Program Specialist II's perform a variety of detailed, specialized program work in public infrastructure management, community development, environmental compliance and/or other designated areas; and perform other related work as required. Positions assigned to this classification are expected to perform varied assignments requiring technical and interpersonal skill in assigned program areas. Work in the class is distinguished from that of the Program Specialist I by the greater complexity of the assignments received and by the greater independence with which the incumbent is expected to operate. This position prepares reports, makes recommendations, and performs monitoring activities. Support is available for problems not covered by reference guidelines, and work is checked occasionally during progress and reviewed upon completion.
  
  
**CURRENT VACANCY**
  
The current vacancy is in the **Environmental Services Division** of the **Public Works Department** and will be **assigned to the City's Clean Water Program** which ensures compliance with federal, state, regional and local mandates associated with stormwater runoff and water quality. Through the implementation of its Clean Water Program, the City of Alameda is committed to performing appropriate municipal services and to providing Alameda residents and businesses practical solutions to help reduce stormwater pollution. The Clean Water Program uses a multi-faceted approach to prevent stormwater pollution including: street sweeping; public outreach and education; new development design review; industrial and commercial facility inspections; construction site inspections; illicit discharge inspections and response/enforcement; trash load reduction; heavy metals and legacy pollutant controls; storm drain system cleaning and maintenance; storm drain system improvements and upgrades (e.g. pump stations, storm mains); participation in the Alameda County Clean Water Program; and contributes to a regional water quality monitoring program. We are seeking someone with specialized knowledge and experience administering similar program elements and working with the public to reduce stormwater pollution.

  

**THE COMMUNITY**

The City of Alameda is a unique island community of approximately 80,000 residents in the San Francisco Bay Area. It is connected to the East Bay mainland by four bridges, two underwater tubes, and by ferry services to San Francisco. Alameda is within minutes of the numerous cultural activities in San Francisco, Oakland and Berkeley. A vibrant community with a rich history and small-town charm, Alameda has a diverse mix of housing, neighborhoods, and pedestrian friendly shopping areas. Charming Victorian homes grace shady tree-lined streets covering the island's 23 square miles.

The City is a full-service organization providing residents with a broad range of municipal services including police and fire protection; construction and maintenance of streets, sewers, storm drains, street lights, and other infrastructure; a state-of-the-art library system; and over 400 acres of parks and recreational facilities including multi-use athletic fields, picnic sites, a skate park, a swim center, and a full service senior center. The City owns and operates Alameda Municipal Power, an electric utility serving the needs of all Alameda residents and businesses. Visit the City of Alameda website at: www.alamedaca.gov

  

**THE PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT**
  
The City of Alameda Public Works Department is the steward of Alameda's public infrastructure, responsible for its design, construction, and maintenance. The Department's Five-Year Strategic Plan organizes the department's work into four key focus areas: Resilient Workforce, Sustainable Funding, Reliable Infrastructure, and Effective Service Delivery. Operationally, the Public Works Department is working to be the best organization in the San Francisco Bay Area with focus on making strides to be at the forefront of Public Works best practices, investing in robust GIS, asset management, permitting, finance systems and much more. Come and join our dynamic team to be an integral part of this vision!

**Distinguishing Features**
---------------------------

**BENEFITS OF EMPLOYMENT**

For a comprehensive listing of benefits, see the Benefit Matrix here.

  

* **Work-Life Balance:** Four-day, 36-hour work week (Monday through Thursday).
* **CalPERS Retirement: Classic Members:** 2% at 55 formula, 8.868% contribution; New Members 2% @ 62 formula, 8.75% contribution.
* **Medical:** The City contracts with CalPERS to provide comprehensive health coverage to employees. Multiple HMO and PPO plans available
* **Dental:** Comprehensive dental coverage provided to employees and their eligible dependents.
* **Vacation:** Starting with 75 hours annually and increasing with years of service.
* **Holidays:** 11 City Holidays and 4 floating Holidays.
* **Sick Leave:** 90 hours annually; unused sick leave is converted to service credit at retirement.

**Examples of Duties**
----------------------

* Participates in the design and implementation of programs and activities. Collects and interprets data and prepares reports.

* Prepares and reviews contracts. Evaluates proposals for funding.

* May prepare documents for grant applications and administration.

* Administers programs to ensure compliance with federal, state, regional and local mandates.

* Monitors project progress and compliance with applicable regulations.

* Provides technical assistance to other divisions, departments, organizations, citizen groups, business, etc.

* Reviews budget and expenditure reports and monitors labor and procurement activities.

* Interprets and applies government regulations.

As the Email Marketing Coordinator at Tatcha you'll be a key member of the eCommerce team. You'll own the day-to-day execution of our email calendar, partner with creative to brief and deliver campaigns on time, and help the team understand what's working through weekly reporting.

Arena is the platform for evaluating how AI models perform in the real world. Founded by researchers from UC Berkeley's SkyLab, we're on a mission to measure and advance the frontier of AI for real-world use, and to build the foundation for everyone to understand, shape, and benefit from it.

Tens of millions of people use Arena each month to evaluate how frontier systems handle the work they actually do. The preferences they share power the most transparent, rigorous, and human-centered evaluations in AI. Leading AI labs, enterprises, and independent researchers rely on our work and open datasets to understand how models behave in real workflows: agentic coding, creative generation, professional productivity, and beyond. We go beyond leaderboards and decompose what human experience reveals about AI, so models advance toward the work people actually do.

We're a team of researchers, academics, builders, and creatives from UC Berkeley, Google, Stanford, and DeepMind. jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

We’re looking for a self-driven, growth-minded account manager with a proven track record of success to join our hybrid- US-based Account Management team. As an account manager at Rippling, you are the CEO of your book of business. You are the primary relationship owner for each of your customers to guide them in optimizing the use of Rippling’s suite of back-office HR products and solutions. You will navigate complex customer issues and priorities and lead initiatives in your book to meet company objectives for customer adoption, retention, and revenue growth. Account managers in our SMB segment own revenue retention and growth of one of our fastest growing customer segments. This is a quota-carrying sales role.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Ensure our customers in the HR Services channel are realizing value and expanding across the platform.
* Proactively engage customers in your book via key lifecycle events: “go live”, introduction calls, benefits renewal, executive business reviews, contract renewal, etc.
* Consult with clients to understand their HR, IT, Finance, and global workforce management needs through a solutions-based approach
* Navigate a strategic sales process by building relationships with multiple external and internal stakeholders through remote and in-person meetings
* Negotiate and coordinate customer procurement and contract execution as part of managing the broader customer relationship
* Build and manage a pipeline of new subscription cross-sales, product upgrades, and contract renewals to monthly targets
* Develop and demonstrate a broad knowledge of current and new Rippling products via executing customer adoption playbooks and prospecting
* Partner with cross-functional product, support, and customer operations teams to ensure customer success and secure long-term commitments, directly influence Rippling’s product roadmap, and increase operational efficiency
* Take an entrepreneurial approach to the role by being a proactive and strategic partner to customers, tailoring your approach to maximize Rippling product adoption based on each customer’s unique business operations

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 2+ years of SaaS experience in account management, sales, or quota-carrying customer success
* Track record of consistently meeting and exceeding quota via new product sales and upgrades (license expansion sales are not likely relevant)
* Competitive and creative drive to win over customers and think outside the box to get a deal done
* Demonstrated ability to run a consultative discovery and demo meeting and run a structured sales process
* Proven success building and maintaining long term commercial relationships
* Highly effective communicator with good people instincts – able to build trust and work well with a diverse group inside and outside the company
* Highly organized, self-motivated, and detail-oriented; great follow-through on projects/tasks big and small
* High integrity; enthusiastic about building a great company for the long term
* Courage to challenge the status quo when logic and reason require it. See something broken? Fix it.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a 40 mile radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

This role will receive a competitive On-Target Earnings (base salary + sales commission) + benefits + equity. The On-Target Earnings\* for employees will be 60/40 commission split for base/variable pay.

jobs.description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

Asset Living is a third-party management firm and a proven partner in fostering thriving communities nationwide. Founded in 1986, Asset Living has decades of experience delivering exceptional value to our partners. Since the beginning, our undeniable passion has driven our organic growth from a small property management firm to one of the most trusted allies in real estate. Asset Living's growing portfolio includes a multitude of properties across the country that span the multifamily, single-family home rentals, affordable housing, build-to-rent, active adult, and student housing divisions.

  

Asset Living is a fast-growing company made up of talented individuals from diverse backgrounds that differentiate us and help us drive innovation and results for our clients and communities across the US. At Asset Living, we wholeheartedly believe 'Together We Lead, Together We Succeed’. We empower each other to lead by example, collaborate, and evolve – inspired by our belief that we can continually improve as individuals and as an organization. Together, we create an environment where every voice is heard, every idea is valued, and every individual experiences opportunities to grow as our company grows. When you join Asset Living, you become part of a dynamic team that thrives on unity, unique talents, and a universal culture of winning.

  

Recognized as one of the nation's Best and Brightest Places to Work and ranked in the NMHC top 50 professionals, join Asset Living because of its reputation as the most trusted partner in real estate, workplace culture, and growth opportunities. Asset Living is a member of The Institute of Real Estate Management (IREM) and is recognized as an Accredited Management Organization (AMO). Together, we lead the way, and together, we achieve excellence in all that we do. Join a workplace where success is a collective journey and leadership is a shared responsibility.

**COMMUNITY MANAGER**

The Community Manager is responsible for overseeing the entire operations of a housing community under the supervision of the Regional Manager. As a Community Manager, you will manage all phases of the operations, including personnel, leasing, maintenance, financial, administration & risk management. As an on-site leader, you will supervise all aspects of the property and staff to ensure compliance with Asset’s policies and procedures, safety and fair housing guidelines, and liability concerns.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* Personnel Management
* Regular/daily onsite attendance is required
* Use consistent techniques & company directives to screen, hire, train, coach, and develop on-site staff
* Ensure the effectiveness of staff through ongoing training, coaching, counseling, and guidance in compliance with Asset training benchmarks.
* Complete weekly/daily office & maintenance staff schedules and assignments
* Deal effectively and consistently with performance problems; document adequately, communicate with direct supervisor and HR, and terminate appropriately when necessary.
* Promote harmony and quality job performance of staff through support and effective leadership
* Ensure staff compliance and consistency with Company policies and procedures
* Financial Management
* Achieve the highest possible net operating income through the implementation of effective cost control and revenue & leasing improvement; identify trends and recommend strategies and adjustments
* Develop yearly operating budgets/forecasts
* Monitor the timely receipt and reconciliation of deposits, rent collections, and charges to ensure they are submitted on a timely basis.
* Monitor the timely receipt, reconciliation, and coding of all vendor invoices
* Ensure property closeout is completed on time and ownership financial reports are accurate
* Strategic Leasing Management
* Develop yearly marketing plan and utilize marketing strategies & systems
* Ensure staff leasing techniques are effective in obtaining closure, follow-up procedures met, signing/documentation of leases, and reporting systems are accurate and up to date.
* Deal with resident complaints, concerns, and requests to ensure resident satisfaction
* Develop and implement resident retention programs (i.e., resident functions, special promotions, monthly newsletter, etc.)
* Effectively show, lease, and move in prospective residents
* Administrative & Maintenance Management
* Ensure all administrative & leasing reporting is accurate, complete, and submitted on a timely basis
* Will head emergency team for the property; ensure proper response and handling of all property emergencies with staff, residents, buildings, etc., within company guidelines to minimize liability.
* Manage excellent customer service and monitor service request turnaround and responsiveness of maintenance staff.
* Maintain property appearance and ensure repairs are noted and completed on a timely basis (this requires regular property inspections and tours)
* Plan for and utilize property resources, equipment, and supplies economically (i.e., obtaining bids/pricing from vendors, suppliers, and contractors, dealing with inadequate service, etc.)
* Give direction to and monitor maintenance, construction, and rehabilitation activities to ensure quality and expediency (i.e., “walk” units to ensure make-ready and work orders are completed)

**Education/experience**

* High School Diploma or Equivalent; Bachelor’s degree preferred or four year’s experience in the housing industry; or one to two years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Certified Apartment Manager (CAM) or Accredited Resident Manager (ARM) preferred.
* Ability to understand and perform all on-site software functions; basic computer skills required.
* Must have basic knowledge of Fair Housing Laws and OSHA requirements.

**Physical requirements**

* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required

Cultivating *the American Dream* is the purpose that binds the Avanath team. At Avanath, every day is an opportunity to make a difference in someone's life. Your success and purpose are driven by the relationships that you build within your communities, including vendor partners and regulatory and social services partnerships. This includes adopting a collaborative approach to create consistently favorable circumstances that foster success and effectiveness for the Organization and the communities.
