jobs.title: Operations Associate
jobs.description:
Do you want to help run a Y-Combinator-backed AI startup from the inside, reporting to the COO and working directly with the entire leadership team? Do you thrive on creating order, and do you love a role where every day looks different? If you want autonomy, room to run, and a clear path to a Chief of Staff role, all at the cutting edge of AI technology in financial services, then read on!

**Who are we?**
---------------

Veritus was born from a simple belief: the conversations between lenders and their customers deserve better technology. We build AI agents that talk with borrowers by voice, text, email, and chat, from the first loan application through the final payment. Our platform is built for lenders, card issuers, and collection agencies who want to transform their operations with AI. Backed by Y Combinator, Crosslink, and Threshold, our AI agents already handle thousands of conversations every day.

We're looking for an Operations Associate who wants to learn how an early-stage startup actually runs by helping run it, and are seeking someone who thrives at the intersection of organization, execution, and AI.

**What will the Operations Associate do?**
------------------------------------------

The Operations Associate keeps Veritus running: the San Francisco office, the leadership team's operating cadence, and the cross-functional projects our COO needs done, so that routine work runs on schedule and every important item gets done.

Reporting directly to our COO, Kasia Gora, you will split your time roughly evenly between running our San Francisco office and owning operational projects for the COO. From the Monday leadership meeting to the holiday party, you will manage meeting materials, OKR tracking, vendors and budgets, interview scheduling, new hire setup, team events, and business travel. You'll work with the COO every day and with the whole leadership team, and there is a clear path to Chief of Staff for the right person.

**Who will love this job?**
---------------------------

* You thrive when you can drive high impact across a whole company, and you bring the same care to every task, big or small. You're energized by learning how an early-stage startup actually runs by helping run it.
* You are relentlessly positive and view yourself as a pillar of company culture, and you get excited by all the possibilities to shape it through your work and interactions.
* You enjoy working in an entrepreneurial, AI-first environment where AI tools are the first thing you reach for.
* You are an execution expert: you keep dozens of open items on track with trackers and checklists, and you finish each one on your own, so the COO only has to ask once.

**JOB SUMMARY**

This position involves providing administrative and analytic support to the Asset Management and Property Management departments with their operational and investment activities of Sobrato’s real estate portfolio. The portfolio consists of approximately 8,000 multifamily units and over 6 million square feet of commercial assets. The portfolio is located along the West Coast with a significant concentration in the SF Bay Area.

The position will have primary responsibilities with the Asset and Property Management departments and will interact with all real estate business groups, including Development, Leasing/Transactions, Portfolio Management, and Sustainability. This role’s specific responsibilities include, but are not limited to, managing due diligence/closing processes, maintaining databases, drafting written correspondence to external parties, and supporting the preparation of budgets. This position involves both individual and collaborative work.

60% of Time

* Maintain property, vendor, and commercial tenant databases by updating contact information, lease information, vendor scheduling, and other key data.
* Draft written correspondence to commercial tenants for lease administrative matters such as rent increases and CAM reimbursement bill backs.
* Assist with contract administration, including (i) preparing and filing proposals/service contracts with 3rd party vendors; (ii) obtaining vendor insurance certificates; and (iii) preparing/filing termination of service letters.

* Provide support with preparing budgets, tenant CAM estimates, and year-end reconciliations.
* Provide support with compiling budgetary expenses for taxes, insurance, and debt service.
* Perform periodic audits of third-party management firms, including expense pass-throughs, incentive compensation, cash retention/disbursement policies, and management fees.
* Manage housing assistance payment allocation and distribution to properties.
* Oversee the process for collection of commercial tenant maintenance records.
* Manage energy reporting systems (Energy Star, Measurabl) for data quality assurance and assist with reporting/benchmarking requirements.
* Manage the annual budget process by creating project timelines, scheduling site inspections, completing data entry, and gathering/filing vendor proposals.
* Establish and maintain relationships with lenders to include coordination of periodic site inspections, quarterly financial reporting, and lender compliance requirements
* Work closely with accounting and finance departments to ensure accurate and timely payments of invoices, particularly property taxes.
* Assist with coding of invoices as needed.
* Review financial reports for aged receivables and payables as needed.

* Manage calendars, coordinate meetings, and conference calls
* File documents as needed.
* Obtain a notary license and notarize internal documents as needed.
* Assist with property tax appeals by gathering requested information and ensuring the appeal continues to progress as needed.
* Review and approve 3rd party reimbursements.
* Take the lead with 3rd party document retention, such as MOR’s and other pertinent financial or operating reports.
* Assist the MF team with preparing the Weekly Rent Summary reporting.

30% of Time

* Lead the process of engaging 3rd party vendors and consultants that will be assisting with the diligence and closing of transactions.

· Track price changes on purchased food and report concerns to the chef and F&B Director

· Track waste, transfers, and family meal usage; report concerns to the chef and F&B Director

· Create spreadsheets to track and generate food costs for all venues separately as needed

· Research and facilitate the purchase of new equipment and manage and maintain all warranties

· Maintain positive relationships with all food vendors, equipment & linen supplies, and repair services

· Create and update worksheets to record monthly inventory

Admin:

**Timing:** Mid-November 2026-June 2027  
**Salary:** $65k-$72k/Annually – Possibilty to convert to a full-time hire  
**Location:** East coast, NY Preferred  
  
**About Us:**  
  
TMB is the community-driven entertainment company engaging more than 250 million consumers worldwide across streaming TV, social media, web and print. Our portfolio of brands including FailArmy, Family Handyman, People Are Awesome, Reader's Digest, Taste of Home, The Healthy, and The Pet Collective, is powered by content that's inspired and created by our fans. Together our community sparks curiosity, fuels laughter, and inspires people to live big, full, fantastic lives. Learn more about our brands, our data-driven marketing solutions, our award-winning licensing services, and much more at trustedmediabrands.com.  
  
**About the role:**  
  
As an Account Manager**,** you are responsible for the customer lifecycle of Trusted Media Brands’ digital, streaming and social business from RFP through campaign renewal. You will own the pre- and post- sale process, spanning media planning, inventory assessment, IO processing, asset collection, performance, billing and wrap-up reports. You serve as the point of contact, both internal and external, for all sales support related inquires on your assigned accounts. As a member of the Account Management team, reporting to the Director of Media Account Management, you will work closely with Sales, Marketing, Activation, Data and AdOps, making you a crucial part of TMB’s growth and overall success.  
  
**Responsibilities:**  

* Responsible for pre-sale media planning and post-sale campaign management
* Strategize RFP response in partnership with Sales & Marketing, providing thoughtful product recommendations that align with client KPIs
* Execute all aspects of assigned TMB media campaigns including order entry, asset collection, client reporting and optimization recommendations
* Work closely with AdOps team to ensure successful delivery and performance of campaigns across display, video, data, branded content, social, streaming, and email/newsletters
* Compile campaign wrap-up reports in partnership with Sales & Marketing; lead client wrap-up calls and presentations
* Deliver exceptional client service and serve as campaign primary point of contact both internally and externally; addressing inquiries, providing updates, and ensuring KPIs are met
* Manage monthly billing and 3rd party reconciliation for campaigns
* Support the Account Management team with ad hoc projects and tasks (i.e. own our TMB Sponsorship & First-Impression Tracker and Newsletter Sponsored Content Block Tracker), and collaborate with the Marketing Activation and Art teams on initiatives to drive efficiency and growth of TMB business

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree
* 1-2 years of experience in media and/or campaign management at an agency/publisher, with a proven track record of collaborating with sales teams and effectively managing client expectations
* Strong multitasking skills in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
* Experience with GAM/DCM or other ad servers
* Excellent client service and communication skills, both written and verbal
* Proficient in media math and MS Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint
* Detail-oriented with a commitment to high-quality work
* Knowledge of GAM, Springserve, Boostr, DoubleVerify, IAS, Permutive
* Familiarity with social platforms *(FB, IG, TT, YT)* and custom content campaign execution

**About the team:**  
  
The Account Management team is continuously evolving to meet the needs of TMB’s digital, streaming and social business and the industry at large. We are a nimble team, with an entrepreneurial spirit to drive growth and new ways of thinking.
  
  
We pride ourselves on excellent customer service which is the driving force in our day-to-day operations. We love connecting our passionate and intent-driven community with relevant brands and products to produce results.  
  
As a cross-functional support team, we thrive on collaboration and communication across various departments. This also provides us a unique perspective to the innerworkings of the company overall and opportunity for continued growth and education.

We value our people and offer a collaborative and engaging culture. As a Trusted Media Brands employee, you will enjoy work/life balance, generous time off and comprehensive benefits and programs. Our ad tech division FreeWheel provides comprehensive adtech that makes it easier to buy and sell premium video advertising across all screens, data types, and sales channels.

The Account Manager is responsible for supporting revenue growth, driving fostering long-term client relationship and client success across linear and digital advertising solutions. This is a critical role serving as a trusted and highly valued strategic partner to sales. The ideal candidate combines sales expertise including prospecting, client servicing and coordination, analytical problem-solving, and client-facing communication skills to support campaign success from pre-sale planning through post-campaign analysis. jobs.description:
**About F. Schumacher & Co**

Schumacher & Co. is a fast-growing and innovative interior design company. We are a technological leader on the design frontier, constantly pushing boundaries and striving for excellence. We are driven by a shared belief that design transforms life. It challenges convention. It brings a unique point of view into the world. It sets trends. And it leaves a mark. F. Schumacher & Co., also known as FSCO, is the parent company of many brands within our portfolio. This role is part of our floorcovering brand, Patterson Flynn.

Patterson Flynn, the rug and carpet atelier, is the ultimate destination for tantalizing products with irrefutable style, premium decorator staples that are the best of their kind, and unparalleled service that is accountable and unconditional.

Our floorcovering brand **Patterson Flynn** is seeking a highly motivated, professional, design savvy Account Manager for our NYC trade - only showroom. The Account Manager represents Patterson Flynn across a geographic territory, bringing our floor covering to the designers and architects shaping the most interesting projects in the market. This is a road-based role. Most of your week is spent where the work happens, in designers' offices, at job sites, and in client presentations, building the relationships that bring new projects our way. This role will be based in NYC, NJ, Connecticut and the Philadelphia metro area.

Responsibilities

Territory and travel

* Own a defined geographic territory and build a weekly plan that keeps you close to your clients.
* Visit designers, architects and project teams at their offices; attend job sites and installations where the project calls for it.
* Analyze the territory to identify growth opportunities among existing accounts and prospects, and prioritize where your time goes.
* Introduce Patterson Flynn to firms who have not yet worked with us, and reconnect with those we have not seen in a while.

Selling and specification

* Maximize sales across all Patterson Flynn categories, including broadloom, custom rugs, and the labor and installation that goes with them.
* Present collections and line shows in a way that is tailored to each client's work and style. Prepare comprehensive proposals and quotes specific to the project, and see them through to close.
* Maintain current knowledge of product, pricing, lead times, competitors and trends, so clients can rely on what you promise them.
* Work with the showroom and workroom teams on samples, custom specifications and installation scheduling.

Pipeline and reporting

* Keep every quote and order current in our sales system, so pipeline and forecast are accurate at any time.
* Stay in regular contact on open quotes.
* Consistent follow-up is what carries a promising project across the line.
* Report on territory performance, forecast expected closings and invoicing, and bring roadblocks to your manager early.
* Provide the highest standard of service throughout, consistent with our position in the luxury market.

Requirements

Essentials

* Enthusiasm for being out in the territory most days
* Dependable transportation and a clean driving record.
* The independence to shape your own week, and the discipline to make the most of it.
* Confidence introducing yourself to firms who do not yet know us, and genuine enjoyment in building a network.

Sales experience

* A track record of setting ambitious sales goals and reaching them, and of guiding a sale through to close.
* Experience managing multiple accounts and building trusting, mutually successful client relationships.
* Ability to establish and execute a multi-brand account strategy in the interior design market.
* Demonstrated ability to identify growth opportunities, including high-potential customers and new accounts.
* Creative thinking to build account-level sales and develop new business in a rapidly changing environment.
* An entrepreneurial mindset and the ambition to build something of your own within an established brand.

General

* Strong organizational and follow-through skills, with real ownership of your territory and its results.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficiency in MS Windows and Office suite; comfort learning our sales and reporting systems.
* Basic knowledge and proficiency with Instagram and social media.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and adapt to change.

Preferred

* Experience selling to the design trade, ideally in floor covering, textiles or another specified product.
* An existing network of designers and architects in the territory.

Your well-being is our top priority. Our benefits and total compensation are designed for the whole person, caring for both you and your family.

* Corporate Annual Profit Sharing

jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

We’re looking for a self-driven, growth-minded account manager with a proven track record of success to join our hybrid- US-based Account Management team. As an account manager at Rippling, you are the CEO of your book of business. You are the primary relationship owner for each of your customers to guide them in optimizing the use of Rippling’s suite of back-office HR products and solutions. You will navigate complex customer issues and priorities and lead initiatives in your book to meet company objectives for customer adoption, retention, and revenue growth. Account managers in our SMB segment own revenue retention and growth of one of our fastest growing customer segments. This is a quota-carrying sales role.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Ensure our customers in the HR Services channel are realizing value and expanding across the platform.
* Proactively engage customers in your book via key lifecycle events: “go live”, introduction calls, benefits renewal, executive business reviews, contract renewal, etc.
* Consult with clients to understand their HR, IT, Finance, and global workforce management needs through a solutions-based approach
* Navigate a strategic sales process by building relationships with multiple external and internal stakeholders through remote and in-person meetings
* Negotiate and coordinate customer procurement and contract execution as part of managing the broader customer relationship
* Build and manage a pipeline of new subscription cross-sales, product upgrades, and contract renewals to monthly targets
* Develop and demonstrate a broad knowledge of current and new Rippling products via executing customer adoption playbooks and prospecting
* Partner with cross-functional product, support, and customer operations teams to ensure customer success and secure long-term commitments, directly influence Rippling’s product roadmap, and increase operational efficiency
* Take an entrepreneurial approach to the role by being a proactive and strategic partner to customers, tailoring your approach to maximize Rippling product adoption based on each customer’s unique business operations

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 2+ years of SaaS experience in account management, sales, or quota-carrying customer success
* Track record of consistently meeting and exceeding quota via new product sales and upgrades (license expansion sales are not likely relevant)
* Competitive and creative drive to win over customers and think outside the box to get a deal done
* Demonstrated ability to run a consultative discovery and demo meeting and run a structured sales process
* Proven success building and maintaining long term commercial relationships
* Highly effective communicator with good people instincts – able to build trust and work well with a diverse group inside and outside the company
* Highly organized, self-motivated, and detail-oriented; great follow-through on projects/tasks big and small
* High integrity; enthusiastic about building a great company for the long term
* Courage to challenge the status quo when logic and reason require it. See something broken? Fix it.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

For office-based employees (employees who live within a 40 mile radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

This role will receive a competitive On-Target Earnings (base salary + sales commission) + benefits + equity. The On-Target Earnings\* for employees will be 60/40 commission split for base/variable pay.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

SANY America is seeking a Key Account Sales Operations Specialist to support its expanding key account business through accurate sales order management, equipment delivery coordination, forecasting, and inventory planning. Working closely with Key Account Managers, Sales Operations, Logistics, Service, Finance, and factory teams, this position helps ensure timely fulfillment of telehandlers and other equipment while delivering a consistent customer experience.

With current revenues over $500 million, SANY America continues to make strong progress and significant investments in the Americas market; the organization is now pursuing an aggressive growth strategy and is looking to move quickly beyond this initial platform and increase its market share.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Sales Order Management**

* Receive, review, and track orders from Key Account Managers; verify pricing, equipment specifications, quantities, delivery requirements, and approved payment terms.

* Compare customer purchase orders with quotations and agreements, resolving discrepancies before processing.

* Enter and maintain orders in applicable systems; communicate inventory availability, production status, lead times, and changes to Key Account Managers.

**Delivery, PDI & Invoicing Coordination**

* Coordinate equipment allocation, pre-delivery inspections (PDI), required modifications, and shipment readiness with internal teams.

* Track delivery schedules, escalate delays affecting customer commitments, and support timely issue resolution.

* Coordinate with Finance on accurate, timely invoicing; maintain purchase orders, approvals, delivery records, and invoices.

**Sales Forecasting & Inventory Planning**

* Consolidate forecasts from Key Account Managers; maintain realistic, expected delivery and invoicing dates.

* Reconcile forecasts against confirmed orders, available inventory, inbound shipments, and factory production schedules.

* Recommend replenishment quantities and configurations based on demand and customer requirements; monitor stock shortages, aging, excess inventory, and turnover.

* Coordinate factory orders and track production schedule changes and estimated arrival dates.

**Key Account Bids & Proposals**

* Coordinate RFP, RFQ, and key account bid responses with the responsible Key Account Manager.

* Maintain requirement checklists, internal owners, document inventories, approval steps, and submission deadlines.

* Gather specifications, delivery commitments, warranty terms, and other inputs from Product, Service, Parts, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders.

* Track clarifications and addenda, coordinate internal reviews and submissions, retain bid records, and transition awarded bids to order processing.

**HQ Coordination, Reporting & Customer Support**

* Serve as a coordination point for factory and headquarters requests involving specifications, production priorities, order changes, and approvals.

* Maintain action trackers and follow up across departments to resolve outstanding matters and improve workflows.

* Prepare regular reports on open orders, delivery status, forecasts, inventory, and outstanding invoicing.

* Provide timely updates to Key Account Managers; proactively flag issues that may affect customer experience.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Associate degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

* Two or more years of experience in sales coordination, order management, logistics, inventory control, or a related operational support function.

* Experience maintaining detailed order records, coordinating across departments, and meeting time-sensitive deadlines.

* Strong Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office skills, with the ability to reconcile, analyze, and communicate operational data.

* Ability to communicate professionally and accurately with internal stakeholders and customer-facing teams.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in business, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or related field.

* Experience in heavy equipment, construction machinery, telehandlers, industrial equipment, or an OEM/dealer environment.

jobs.title: Sales Arborist / Arborist Account Manager
jobs.description:
***Are you a high-performing sales professional with great people skills, tree-care knowledge, and the drive to grow a premium territory?***

***Joshua Tree Experts*** is expanding in NE Atlanta, and we're seeking a results-driven ***Sales Arborist*** to grow our business across **Norcoss, Peachtree Corners, Sandy Springs, Embry Hills,** and the surrounding areas. Our yard is located in **Norcross**, providing a home base for serving these communities.

This is an opportunity to sell comprehensive tree-care solutions-not just tree removal and pruning, but also **Plant Health Care** programs that help clients protect the health and long-term value of their landscapes. You'll partner with another sales arborist serving neighboring Atlanta territories, with company-supported marketing and digital lead generation to help fuel your success.

**The Role**
------------

The Arborist Account Manager is a year-round career focused on consultative sales, territory growth, and long-term client relationships. As the face of the "Joshua Tree Experience," you'll evaluate properties, identify tree and plant health needs, and close premium service agreements.

We're looking for someone who can turn an initial tree-care inquiry into a lasting client relationship by recommending both immediate services and ongoing care.

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* Territory Growth: Actively prospect, generate referrals, and build new business throughout Norcoss, Peachtree Corners, Sandy Springs, Embry Hills and the surrounding areas. Leverage company-supported marketing campaigns and digital leads while developing your own pipeline.
* Comprehensive Tree-Care Sales: Sell tree removal, pruning, and plant health care services through a consultative, relationship-based approach.
* Plant Health Care Development: Identify opportunities for ongoing plant health care programs, educate clients on recommended services, and build recurring client relationships.
* Property AssessmentsProposals: Conduct thorough site inspections, evaluate client needs, determine accurate job costs, and deliver clear, professional proposals.
* Client Experience: Provide prompt follow-up after services, ensure client satisfaction, and generate repeat business and referrals.
* Operational Partnership: Collaborate with office staff and production crews to communicate job scopes, client expectations, and service requirements.
* Brand Ambassadorship: Model our core values: ***Reliable, Team Player, ImproveAdapt,*** and ***Find A Way***.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 4+ years of proven success in outside sales, B2C sales, or territory management - required.
* Knowledge of plant health care programs and the ability to explain and sell them effectively - required.
* General tree-care knowledge, including tree removal and pruning services.
* ISA Certified Arborist credential - preferred.
* Georgia pesticide applicator's license - preferred.
* Strong prospecting, relationship-building, negotiation, and closing skills.
* Comfort working with computer systems, mobile technology, and digital proposals; CRM experience is a major plus.
* Valid driver's license, clean driving record, and flexibility to accommodate client schedules.

**Compensation and Benefits**
-----------------------------

This is a commission-driven sales opportunity for someone motivated by performance-based earnings.

Total Annual Earning Potential: 110,000–150,000 through base salary and commissions. Actual earnings depend on individual sales results; this range is not guaranteed

* -but is more than possible!
* Health, dental, and vision insurance with shared-cost options.
* Company-paid short-term disability insurance.
* Six paid holidays and five days of PTO, with PTO increasing each year of service.
* Company-owned sales vehicle for sales calls, with take-home privileges. Personal use is not permitted due to insurance limitations.
* Company-provided cell phone and tablet.
* Ongoing professional development, including company-paid exam fees, license renewals, and continuing education for credentials deemed necessary for the role.

**Why Joshua Tree Experts?**
----------------------------

We combine old-school values with modern technology to support our team's success. You'll have the autonomy to manage your day, company-supported lead generation, and the opportunity to grow both project-based tree-care sales and ongoing plant health care relationships throughout North East Atlanta.

If you're ready to build a territory, develop lasting client relationships, and earn based on your results, apply today to start the conversation!

* Track board motions, approvals and follow-up items to ensure timely execution
* Maintain bylaws, committee charters, board rosters and governance documentation
* Coordinate annual board calendar, including grant cycles and reporting timelines
* Support board onboarding and orientation materials for new members
* Maintain secure archival records of board materials and historical decisions
* Assist in preparation of board presentations and executive-level materials

  + 990 reviews
  + EIN confirmation
  + Eligibility documentation
* Maintain organized electronic grant files and documentation records
* Assist in monitoring completion of compliance checklists and internal control procedures
* Coordinate with Finance to ensure payment documentation and grant records are properly archived
* Support audit, tax and 990 filing preparation by compiling requested documentation and maintaining accurate records

**Systems & Administrative Coordination**

* Provide administrative support for CRM and database maintenance, including data entry, record updates and document uploads
* Assist with data cleanup projects and preparation of materials for system uploads
* Support the preparation and distribution of standard reports and dashboards developed by the Director, Foundation Operations & Impact
* Maintain organized electronic filing systems to ensure consistency and accessibility
* Assist with portal coordination and user communication related to grant submissions
* Identify opportunities to improve administrative workflows and documentation processes

**Foundation Administrative & Operational Support**

* Provide calendar management and scheduling support for Foundation leadership and staff
* Coordinate internal and cross-functional meetings (HR, IT, Finance, Communications)
* Track contracts, vendor agreements and renewal timelines
* Assist in preparation of internal presentations, updates and briefing materials
* Support planning and logistics for Foundation events and employee engagement initiatives
* Maintain master calendars for grant cycles, campaigns and reporting deadlines
* Manage document templates, shared drives and standardized materials
* Take on special projects and discrete assignments as needed

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of executive assistant, foundation administration, corporate or nonprofit operations or governance experience
* Experience supporting boards and staff teams
* Familiarity with grant compliance, nonprofit safeguards or regulatory documentation
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Comfort with database entry and documentation systems
* High discretion and integrity

* Delivers results and drives customer success by committing and focusing on outcomes to deliver results and making the customer the center of decisions.
* Make balanced decisions and thinks strategically by being a forward thinker.

jobs.description:
**About the Business**

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Insurance vertical, we provide customers with solutions and decision tools that combine public and industry specific content with advanced technology and analytics to assist them in evaluating and predicting risk and enhancing operational efficiency. Our insurance risk solutions help drive better data-driven decisions across the insurance policy lifecycle, all while reducing risk. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at https://risk.lexisnexis.com/insurance.

  

**About Our Team**
------------------

At LexisNexis Risk Solutions, we help insurance organizations make smarter, data-driven decisions throughout the policy lifecycle. Our team supports customers by obtaining and managing critical records and documentation that contribute to accurate risk assessment and operational efficiency. As part of a collaborative, fast-paced production environment, we work closely with internal partners, law enforcement agencies, and other external resources to deliver high-quality results that help our customers reduce risk and improve outcomes. We are committed to accuracy, teamwork, and exceptional service, creating an environment where employees can learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact every day.

  
  

**About the Role**

As a Records Acquisition Specialist, you will support insurance customers by researching, obtaining, and maintaining police records and related documentation. You will work with internal and external resources, including law enforcement agencies, to help ensure records are accurate, complete, and delivered in accordance with company standards. This role is onsite five days per week and offers the opportunity to contribute to a collaborative, production-focused environment.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Research and review requests and police records information from websites and various internal and external databases.
* Fulfill, edit, and modify requests for police records to ensure compliance with company standards and completeness of orders for product delivery.
* Perform additional research as required to meet customer expectations.
* Meet and exceed established departmental goals for productivity and accuracy.
* Conduct outgoing calls to agencies regarding requests.
* Review, compile, acquire, organize, and maintain records.
* Apply an understanding of records procurement processes for insurance purposes.
Support the delivery of high-quality customer outcomes through accurate record management.  

  

**Requirements**

* Customer service skills with a focus on creating, maintaining, and enhancing customer relationships.
* Experience in Criminal Justice, Insurance Claims, Call Center environments, and/or police departments. (Preferred not required)
* Ability to use Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Ability to learn quickly and thrive in a production-based environment.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* High school diploma required.
* Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional customer service and support.
* Salesforce knowledge is a plus.

U.S. National Base Pay Range: $33,500 - $55,700. Geographic differentials may apply in some locations to better reflect local market rates.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
The Executive Assistant provides comprehensive administrative, operational, and project support to the Demand Generation Leadership Team (DGLT). This role serves as a trusted partner to the leadership team by managing complex priorities, coordinating executive communications, facilitating key business rhythms, and ensuring effective execution of strategic and operational initiatives.

The position requires exceptional organizational skills, strong business acumen, sound judgment, and the ability to successfully support multiple senior leaders in a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate is highly proactive, detail-oriented, and able to manage competing priorities with professionalism, a high degree of discretion, and accountability.

**Responsibilities**:

**Leadership Team Support**

* Provide executive-level administrative support to the Demand Generation Leadership Team (DGLT), including the SVP and designated Vice Presidents.
* Manage complex, multi-leader calendars, balancing competing priorities and scheduling demands.
* Coordinate executive communications with a high degree of discretion and confidentiality.
* Serve as a key liaison between leadership, internal partners, and external stakeholders.
* Anticipate leadership needs and proactively identify solutions to scheduling, communication, and operational challenges.
* Ensure leader priorities, commitments, and follow-up actions are effectively managed and completed.
* Enable alignment and coordination across leaders and teams.

**Meeting & Event Coordination**

* Plan and execute leadership meetings, offsites, and business reviews.
* Coordinate agendas, logistics, and supporting materials.
* Prepare pre-read materials, reports, and briefing documents.
* Track action items, decisions, and follow-up activities to ensure timely completion.
* Manage meeting logistics, including conference rooms, catering, technology, and attendee communications.

**Travel & Expense Management**

* Coordinate travel arrangements for leadership team members in alignment with company policy
* Prepare and submit expense reports accurately and timely

**Office & Operational Management**

* Maintain office equipment and supplies; oversee updates to business cards and stationery
* Process and track vendor invoices; support department budget tracking in partnership with Finance and Procurement
* Manage jet tracking and related documentation for Finance and Tax/Audit requirements
* Maintain shared drives and document repositories to ensure materials are current, organized, and accessible

**Strategic & Project Support**

* Conduct research, prepare briefing documents, and summarize insights to support Demand Generation strategic initiatives.
* Track and report on key projects, priorities, and deliverables to ensure alignment with leadership objectives.
* Prepare executive presentations, reports, and business review materials.
* Support executive communications and presentation development for internal and external audiences.
* Coordinate leadership operating rhythms, including staff meetings, planning sessions, and business reviews.

**Team Engagement & Culture**

* Coordinate department-wide activities, celebrations, and offsites to foster team morale and cohesion
* Support internal communications and drive participation in culture-building initiatives
* Help reinforce a collaborative, high-performing leadership team environment

**Requirements:**

* 4 Year Degree
* ***Minimum***: 5+ years of Executive Assistant or senior administrative support experience.
* Experience supporting Vice Presidents, Senior Vice Presidents, or other executive-level leaders in a fast-paced corporate environment.
* ***Preferred***: Experience supporting multiple executives simultaneously.
* Experience coordinating executive meetings, offsites, and strategic initiatives.

**About Wolf Electric Supply Company**

Wolf Electric Supply Company is an electrical wholesale distributor that supplies electrical contractors with lighting, switchgear, wire, conduit, and other electrical materials for commercial and industrial construction projects. Established in 1986, the company serves the Chicagoland region and supports projects of varying sizes through product sourcing, material procurement, quotations, and delivery coordination.

With access to more than 100 product lines, Wolf Electric Supply helps electrical contractors obtain the materials they need to keep construction projects moving efficiently. Its additional services include fixture storage, wire reeling, and used lighting recycling. The company combines electrical product expertise with personalized service to support contractors, project teams, and construction-related businesses. Wolf Electric Supply Co.

We are seeking a detail-oriented Electrical Project Coordinator to support the coordination of electrical materials, project orders, supplier communications, and delivery schedules. This position is suited to an organized professional with experience or an interest in construction coordination, electrical distribution, purchasing, order management, or project administration.

The successful candidate will help ensure that electrical materials are accurately quoted, properly tracked, and coordinated with customer requirements and project schedules.

**Job Summary**

Wolf Electric Supply Company is seeking an Electrical Project Coordinator to support the coordination of electrical supply requirements for commercial and industrial construction projects.

This position will help manage project-related material requests, quotations, purchase orders, product availability, order status updates, and delivery schedules. Working with inside sales, outside sales, purchasing, warehouse personnel, suppliers, and electrical contractors, the coordinator will help ensure that project materials are processed accurately and delivered according to established timelines.

The role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, effective communication, and the ability to manage multiple project orders simultaneously. The coordinator will also help maintain accurate project documentation, follow up on outstanding materials, and communicate potential supply delays to the appropriate team members.

This is an opportunity for an early-career or developing professional to build industry knowledge in electrical wholesale distribution while gaining practical experience in construction material coordination, procurement support, and project operations.

**Why Join Our Team?**

* Join Wolf Electric Supply Company and build your career in the electrical distribution and construction supply industry. You will gain practical experience coordinating electrical materials, supporting contractor requirements, tracking project orders, and helping commercial and industrial construction projects stay on schedule.
* Work alongside sales, purchasing, warehouse, and supplier teams to understand how electrical products move from procurement through order fulfilment and delivery. \*

* 6. Coordinate with purchasing personnel and suppliers to check product availability, confirm lead times, and follow up on delayed or backordered electrical materials.
* 7. Track the status of lighting fixtures, switchgear, wire, conduit, fittings, and other electrical products required for active construction projects.
* 8. Maintain project tracking spreadsheets, order logs, quotation records, delivery schedules, and other documentation used to monitor material requirements and fulfilment progress.
* 9. Identify discrepancies between requested materials, quoted products, purchase orders, and customer orders; coordinate corrections with the appropriate departments.

jobs.title: Ecommerce Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Overview of Position**

The Ecommerce Coordinator keeps our products accurate, visible, and easy to buy online, every single day. You will manage listings across several ecommerce platforms, build promotions, write product copy, and help turn our data into decisions.

This is not a typical direct-to-consumer ecommerce job. Online ordering here sits inside a larger business: it works alongside our sales team, our customer service staff, our physical locations, and an ERP that runs the whole operation. Many of our customers buy from us in more than one way. Your job is to make the online channel strengthen those relationships, not compete with them.

We are looking for someone who sees ecommerce as part of an ecosystem. You understand that a listing error can affect a sales rep's conversation, that a promotion has to make sense for inventory and margin, and that the best online experience is the one that makes the rest of the business work better.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

**Own the daily online presence of our products**

* Keep product listings accurate and current: pricing, availability, images, attributes, and categories.
* Audit listings regularly and fix errors before customers or sales staff find them.
* Launch new products and retire discontinued ones on schedule.

**Work across multiple ecommerce platforms**

* Manage our storefronts on Shopify and the other platforms we sell through.
* Learn new platforms quickly as our channels change, and document how each one works.
* Keep product information consistent across every channel.
* Build and run promotions
* Set up discounts, featured collections, bundles, and seasonal campaigns.
* Coordinate timing with purchasing, sales, and marketing so promotions match inventory and goals.
* Test every promotion before launch and confirm it performs as intended after.

**Write product copy**

* Write clear, accurate product titles and descriptions that help customers buy with confidence.
* Follow our brand voice and search best practices.
* Maintain copy standards and templates so listings stay consistent.

**Contribute to reporting and find opportunities**

* Pull and prepare regular reports on sales, traffic, conversion, and promotion results.
* Spot trends, gaps, and underperforming products, and recommend what to do about them.
* Share findings in plain language with teams outside ecommerce.

**Use NetSuite**

* Maintain item records and product data in NetSuite.
* Run saved searches and reports to support ecommerce work.
* Make sure data flows correctly between NetSuite and our ecommerce platforms, and troubleshoot when it doesn't.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* 2+ years of hands-on ecommerce experience, managing product listings or storefront operations.
* Working knowledge of at least one major ecommerce platform, and confidence learning new ones fast.
* Strong analytical skills: comfortable with spreadsheets, pivot tables, and reading dashboards.
* Clear, accurate writing, with an eye for detail in product copy and data.
* Experience setting up promotions, discounts, or campaigns on an ecommerce platform.
* An understanding of how ecommerce connects to sales, inventory, and customer service, not just marketing.
* Organized and dependable with recurring daily work, while juggling projects and deadlines.
* Comfortable working with people across departments, including those who don't work in ecommerce.

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Shopify experience, including apps, collections, and discount setup.
* NetSuite experience, especially item records and saved searches.
* B2B, wholesale, or multi-channel ecommerce experience.
* Experience with seasonal, perishable, or fast-changing inventory.
* Familiarity with Google Analytics or similar web analytics tools.
* Basic SEO knowledge and experience with bulk product imports (CSV).conversation.

jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

We’re looking for a self-driven, growth-minded account manager with a proven track record of success to join our hybrid- US-based Account Management team. As an account manager at Rippling, you are the CEO of your book of business. You are the primary relationship owner for each of your customers to guide them in optimizing the use of Rippling’s suite of back-office HR products and solutions. You will navigate complex customer issues and priorities and lead initiatives in your book to meet company objectives for customer adoption, retention, and revenue growth. Account managers in our SMB segment own revenue retention and growth of one of our fastest growing customer segments. This is a quota-carrying sales role.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Ensure our customers in the HR Services channel are realizing value and expanding across the platform.
* Proactively engage customers in your book via key lifecycle events: “go live”, introduction calls, benefits renewal, executive business reviews, contract renewal, etc.
* Consult with clients to understand their HR, IT, Finance, and global workforce management needs through a solutions-based approach
* Navigate a strategic sales process by building relationships with multiple external and internal stakeholders through remote and in-person meetings
* Negotiate and coordinate customer procurement and contract execution as part of managing the broader customer relationship
* Build and manage a pipeline of new subscription cross-sales, product upgrades, and contract renewals to monthly targets
* Develop and demonstrate a broad knowledge of current and new Rippling products via executing customer adoption playbooks and prospecting
* Partner with cross-functional product, support, and customer operations teams to ensure customer success and secure long-term commitments, directly influence Rippling’s product roadmap, and increase operational efficiency
* Take an entrepreneurial approach to the role by being a proactive and strategic partner to customers, tailoring your approach to maximize Rippling product adoption based on each customer’s unique business operations

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 2+ years of SaaS experience in account management, sales, or quota-carrying customer success
* Track record of consistently meeting and exceeding quota via new product sales and upgrades (license expansion sales are not likely relevant)
* Competitive and creative drive to win over customers and think outside the box to get a deal done
* Demonstrated ability to run a consultative discovery and demo meeting and run a structured sales process
* Proven success building and maintaining long term commercial relationships
* Highly effective communicator with good people instincts – able to build trust and work well with a diverse group inside and outside the company
* Highly organized, self-motivated, and detail-oriented; great follow-through on projects/tasks big and small
* High integrity; enthusiastic about building a great company for the long term
* Courage to challenge the status quo when logic and reason require it. See something broken? Fix it.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a 40 mile radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

This role will receive a competitive On-Target Earnings (base salary + sales commission) + benefits + equity. The On-Target Earnings\* for employees will be 60/40 commission split for base/variable pay.

This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. The salary for US-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here.

* Commission is not guaranteed

jobs.title: Manager, Strategy & Revenue Operations
jobs.description:
**Chowbus** is a leading Asian restaurant technology SaaS platform, with deep roots in the North American market for years. Currently, we stand as a pioneering enterprise in the North American Asian Restaurant SaaS sector. Driven by precise market positioning and efficient product services, our business has achieved doubled growth annually, covering over 30 core states and 100 key cities across the U.S., and partnering with more than 10,000 Asian restaurants. We build tech ecosystems that help restaurants grow, serve with heart, and uplift their communities. Our vision is to create a world where culturally rooted food entrepreneurs thrive everywhere.

We build technology solutions across POS, AI, and digital tools that help restaurant operators improve efficiency, reduce operating costs, and grow their businesses. As our sales organization grows, we are looking for a Manager of Strategy & Revenue Operations to work directly with our VP of Sales.

**How This Role Is Different**
------------------------------

This is not a strategy leadership role. You won't be expected to set the company's sales strategy or own pricing decisions. Instead, you'll be the person who makes the VP of Sales more effective: pulling the data, preparing the meetings, tracking the follow-ups, running the analysis behind the decisions, and keeping the sales operations engine running. It's an execution-focused role with direct exposure to how sales leadership thinks and operates, and a strong path to grow into strategy or revenue operations leadership over time.

### **What You'll Focus On**

### **Sales Data & Reporting**

* Build and maintain weekly and monthly reports on pipeline, bookings, forecast and rep performance.
* Keep CRM data clean and accurate; flag gaps and follow up with sales teams to fix them.
* Run ad-hoc analysis quickly when the VP needs an answer.

### **Meetings & Operating Cadence**

* Prepare agendas, materials and decks for weekly sales meetings, pipeline reviews, QBRs and leadership meetings.
* Take notes, track action items and follow up until they're done.

### **Project & Analysis Support**

* Support the VP on territory planning, quota setting, pricing analysis and competitor research.
* Gather data, build models and turn findings into clear, concise summaries.

### **Sales Operations Support**

* Review and process deal paperwork, including quotes, discount approvals, contracts and order forms, and make sure they follow company policy.
* Calculate and reconcile monthly sales commissions with Finance, and answer reps' questions.
* Manage CRM and sales tools, including user setup, permissions, fields and workflows.
* Coordinate the handoff from Sales to Onboarding/Implementation so new merchants go live smoothly.
* Support new sales rep onboarding with account setup, training materials and process guides.
* Write and update sales policies, processes and SOPs, and make sure the team knows about changes.

### **Executive Support & Coordination**

* Serve as the VP of Sales' go-to person for whatever needs to get done, from preparing a board slide to chasing down a number.
* Coordinate with Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, Product and our China-based teams to keep work moving.
* Travel regularly with the VP of Sales for sales team meetings, market visits, customer meetings and industry events, handling logistics, materials and follow-ups.

### **What You Bring**

* 2–4 years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, business operations, consulting, finance or data analytics
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills; experience with Salesforce or another CRM
* Able to build clear, polished presentations and summarize findings concisely
* Highly organized and detail-oriented; comfortable juggling many tasks at once
* Proactive and low-ego: happy to take on whatever the team needs, big or small
* Comfortable with a meeting-heavy schedule, including regular evening meetings with our China-based teams
* Willingness and ability to travel regularly
* Fluency in both English and Mandarin Chinese is required
* Ability to work from the Chowbus Chicago office

### **Nice to Have**

* SQL, Tableau or other BI tools
* Experience in SaaS, POS, payments or restaurant technology

### **What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation package
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k)
* 100% employer-paid Short-Term Disability (STD)
* 100% employer-paid Life Insurance
* 100% employer-paid AD&D Insurance
* Company holidays
* Birthday off
* Paid Parental Leave
* Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Monthly Stipend
* Direct exposure to North America leadership and the opportunity to shape Chowbus' next stage of growth

**The salary for this role is $100,000–$150,000 base plus bonus, depending on experience.**

new_jobs.title: Faculty Support and Academic Program Coordinator, Office of Faculty Support and Academic Success Program
new_jobs.description:
Founded in 1896, the Gould School of Law has a distinguished past built on the principles of equity and excellence, and the courage to break new ground. USC first introduced legal education in Southern California. Today, the Law School continues to make history through its philosophy of innovation and through its people. USC Gould cultivates analytical ability, ethical values, and a spirit of collegiality that prepare students for meaningful careers benefiting society. It was one of the first law schools to engage students in clinical programs and remains a leader in experiential education.

The Gould School of Law is seeking to hire a Faculty Support Coordinator to join the Office of Faculty Support and support the Academic Success Program. This position will report to the Director of Faculty Support, and will assist a number of faculty with their research and teaching needs. The number of faculty assigned may vary throughout the year

**ATTENTION:** This position is full-time, benefits-eligible, and 1-year fixed term. Applicants must upload a cover letter and a resume to be considered for this position.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Preferred Education: Bachelor's degree in legal studies
* Preferred Experience: Experience in higher education

**Job Accountabilities:**

  

This position involves a variety of administrative tasks that include, but are not limited to, the following:

**50% Faculty Support**

  

* Directly completes work assignments from professors, including scanning and making photocopies, drafting and formatting letters of recommendation for students, proofreading and editing documents, ordering supplies, answering incoming calls and emails, managing and coordinating schedules.
* Helps prepare course materials, coordinates exams, takes class attendance, assists in the ordering of textbooks and additional resources, organizes and edits PowerPoint presentations, spreadsheets, and classroom handouts.
* Posts assignments, announcements, and readings to Brightspace, records grades, releases class recordings, and oversees other relevant course content.
* Arranges travel and parking reservations for faculty and guest speakers.
* Processes reimbursement requests for faculty travel and other university expenses.
* Sorts and sends mail, letters, and packages.
* Assists in event planning, including reserving meeting spaces, ordering catering, setting up rooms, coordinating speaking engagements for law professors, and other logistical needs.
* Lends classroom support to faculty to ensure that they know how to operate audio-visual equipment. Helps troubleshoot any IT issues.
* Files and/or transcribes legal documents.
* Will assist with both final exam administration and proctoring at the end of the Fall and Spring semesters and commencement each year.
* Perform other related duties as assigned or requested. The university reserves the right to add or change duties at any time.

**50% Academic Success Program (ASP):**

Gould’s ASP is a comprehensive program that assists JD students from admission to law school through admission to the bar. This means that ASP has programming, communications, events, and services on a 12-month schedule. The ASP is staffed by its director and associate director (both of whom are Gould faculty members), six ASP Fellows (who are upper division law students), and two Alumni Bar Coaches (who are recent Gould graduates). The program looks forward to welcoming a dedicated Faculty Support Coordinator to help with many tasks, including but not limited to those listed below. There will be other duties related to the program that are assigned or requested on an ad hoc basis and as the program changes.

The ASP Support Coordinator will also work with the faculty to create systems to make all of the ASP administrative tasks more routine and efficient, including developing ASP calendaring systems, tracking student communications, and creating instructions for how to complete required administrative tasks.

The ASP Support Coordinator will deal with students and with sensitive student data (including GPA data). As such, the ASP Support Coordinator must be highly respectful of confidentiality and privacy concerns.

It will be important for the ASP Support Coordinator to be present, on-campus dependably on at least three days per week, and on other days as needed. For example, the ASP Support Coordinator will be expected to be on campus on ASP workshop days, and during summer programs including the simulated bar exam (early July), Gould Preview (early-to-mid August), and Orientation (mid-August).

The administrative responsibilities of the ASP Support Coordinator include both those listed above under Faculty Support and the following, which is a non-exhaustive list:

  

* Creating, updating, and disseminating flyers and other publicity to promote ASP events
* Scheduling rooms and communications with other departments (often having to reschedule rooms at last minute because of double-booked events)
* Ordering and delivering food for ASP events and workshops
* Creating and administering surveys for a variety of purposes including surveys to evaluate the ASP’s events, workshops, courses, and other programs
* Updating content and posting announcements on the ASP Brightspace page
* Coordinating with ASP Fellows, alumni bar coaches, and student and alumni volunteers on events, workshops, and projects
* Outreach to other faculty to coordinate teaching schedules, reading assignments, etc. for Gould Preview and other ASP programs

* Working with Gould’s Events team on ASP events and workshops
* Updating regular and ongoing monthly (and during spring and summer, weekly) email communications for students and recent graduates

**Salary Range:** **$26.00 - $28.00/ Hourly**

SUMMARY: This role provides coordination and administrative support to the trade marketing team, serving as the central coordinator for all trade marketing plans managed by Marketing. Positioned between the marketing and sales functions, the Trade Marketing Coordinator manages trade plan requests in Asana, tracks and reconciles invoices against approved plans, and ensures marketing collateral and deliverables reach the sales team on time. Working closely with marketing and sales team members, this role helps integrate trade and direct marketing plans so both teams stay aligned, informed, and on schedule.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

* Serve as the coordinator for all trade marketing plans managed by the Marketing team, maintaining plan details, timelines, budgets, and deliverables in a central, up-to-date view.

* Track and compare trade partner and vendor invoices against approved trade plans, flagging discrepancies, overages, or undelivered items and following up with stakeholders to resolve them.
* Ensure marketing collateral and deliverables are shared with the sales team on time, coordinating deadlines and communicating updates or changes as they arise.
* Support the integration of trade and direct marketing plans, helping align timing, offers, and messaging across channels so the two plans work together.

* Support trade shows, sales events, and partner programs as needed, including logistics, materials, vendor communication, and attendee coordination.
* Prepare status reports, trackers, and meeting notes to provide visibility into trade plan progress, planned versus actual spend, and team priorities.

* Provide general administrative support to the Marketing team as needed.
* Perform other related duties as assigned by management.

* Cost Consciousness - Works within approved budget; Develops and implements cost saving measures; Contributes to profits and revenue; Conserves organizational resources.
* Teamwork - Balances team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit; Puts success of team above own interests; Able to build morale and group commitments to goals and objectives; Supports everyone's efforts to succeed.

Pressed Juicery’s mission is to empower your wellness journey.

**Nature of Position**
----------------------

**THE POSITION**

The City of Alameda is seeking to fill a **Program Specialist II** position **to administer the City's Clean Water Program activities.** Under direction, Program Specialist II's perform a variety of detailed, specialized program work in public infrastructure management, community development, environmental compliance and/or other designated areas; and perform other related work as required. Positions assigned to this classification are expected to perform varied assignments requiring technical and interpersonal skill in assigned program areas. Work in the class is distinguished from that of the Program Specialist I by the greater complexity of the assignments received and by the greater independence with which the incumbent is expected to operate. This position prepares reports, makes recommendations, and performs monitoring activities. Support is available for problems not covered by reference guidelines, and work is checked occasionally during progress and reviewed upon completion.
  
  
**CURRENT VACANCY**
  
The current vacancy is in the **Environmental Services Division** of the **Public Works Department** and will be **assigned to the City's Clean Water Program** which ensures compliance with federal, state, regional and local mandates associated with stormwater runoff and water quality. Through the implementation of its Clean Water Program, the City of Alameda is committed to performing appropriate municipal services and to providing Alameda residents and businesses practical solutions to help reduce stormwater pollution. The Clean Water Program uses a multi-faceted approach to prevent stormwater pollution including: street sweeping; public outreach and education; new development design review; industrial and commercial facility inspections; construction site inspections; illicit discharge inspections and response/enforcement; trash load reduction; heavy metals and legacy pollutant controls; storm drain system cleaning and maintenance; storm drain system improvements and upgrades (e.g. pump stations, storm mains); participation in the Alameda County Clean Water Program; and contributes to a regional water quality monitoring program. We are seeking someone with specialized knowledge and experience administering similar program elements and working with the public to reduce stormwater pollution.

  

**THE COMMUNITY**

The City of Alameda is a unique island community of approximately 80,000 residents in the San Francisco Bay Area. It is connected to the East Bay mainland by four bridges, two underwater tubes, and by ferry services to San Francisco. Alameda is within minutes of the numerous cultural activities in San Francisco, Oakland and Berkeley. A vibrant community with a rich history and small-town charm, Alameda has a diverse mix of housing, neighborhoods, and pedestrian friendly shopping areas. Charming Victorian homes grace shady tree-lined streets covering the island's 23 square miles.

The City is a full-service organization providing residents with a broad range of municipal services including police and fire protection; construction and maintenance of streets, sewers, storm drains, street lights, and other infrastructure; a state-of-the-art library system; and over 400 acres of parks and recreational facilities including multi-use athletic fields, picnic sites, a skate park, a swim center, and a full service senior center. The City owns and operates Alameda Municipal Power, an electric utility serving the needs of all Alameda residents and businesses. Visit the City of Alameda website at: www.alamedaca.gov

  

**THE PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT**
  
The City of Alameda Public Works Department is the steward of Alameda's public infrastructure, responsible for its design, construction, and maintenance. The Department's Five-Year Strategic Plan organizes the department's work into four key focus areas: Resilient Workforce, Sustainable Funding, Reliable Infrastructure, and Effective Service Delivery. Operationally, the Public Works Department is working to be the best organization in the San Francisco Bay Area with focus on making strides to be at the forefront of Public Works best practices, investing in robust GIS, asset management, permitting, finance systems and much more. Come and join our dynamic team to be an integral part of this vision!

---------------------------

* **Vacation:** Starting with 75 hours annually and increasing with years of service.
* **Holidays:** 11 City Holidays and 4 floating Holidays.
* **Sick Leave:** 90 hours annually; unused sick leave is converted to service credit at retirement.

new_jobs.title: Ecommerce Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Overview of Position**

The Ecommerce Coordinator keeps our products accurate, visible, and easy to buy online, every single day. You will manage listings across several ecommerce platforms, build promotions, write product copy, and help turn our data into decisions.

This is not a typical direct-to-consumer ecommerce job. Online ordering here sits inside a larger business: it works alongside our sales team, our customer service staff, our physical locations, and an ERP that runs the whole operation. Many of our customers buy from us in more than one way. Your job is to make the online channel strengthen those relationships, not compete with them.

We are looking for someone who sees ecommerce as part of an ecosystem. You understand that a listing error can affect a sales rep's conversation, that a promotion has to make sense for inventory and margin, and that the best online experience is the one that makes the rest of the business work better.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

**Own the daily online presence of our products**

* Keep product listings accurate and current: pricing, availability, images, attributes, and categories.
* Audit listings regularly and fix errors before customers or sales staff find them.
* Launch new products and retire discontinued ones on schedule.

**Work across multiple ecommerce platforms**

* Manage our storefronts on Shopify and the other platforms we sell through.
* Learn new platforms quickly as our channels change, and document how each one works.
* Keep product information consistent across every channel.
* Build and run promotions
* Set up discounts, featured collections, bundles, and seasonal campaigns.
* Coordinate timing with purchasing, sales, and marketing so promotions match inventory and goals.
* Test every promotion before launch and confirm it performs as intended after.

**Write product copy**

* Write clear, accurate product titles and descriptions that help customers buy with confidence.
* Follow our brand voice and search best practices.
* Maintain copy standards and templates so listings stay consistent.

**Contribute to reporting and find opportunities**

* Pull and prepare regular reports on sales, traffic, conversion, and promotion results.
* Spot trends, gaps, and underperforming products, and recommend what to do about them.
* Share findings in plain language with teams outside ecommerce.

**Use NetSuite**

* Maintain item records and product data in NetSuite.
* Run saved searches and reports to support ecommerce work.
* Make sure data flows correctly between NetSuite and our ecommerce platforms, and troubleshoot when it doesn't.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* 2+ years of hands-on ecommerce experience, managing product listings or storefront operations.
* Working knowledge of at least one major ecommerce platform, and confidence learning new ones fast.
* Strong analytical skills: comfortable with spreadsheets, pivot tables, and reading dashboards.
* Clear, accurate writing, with an eye for detail in product copy and data.
* Experience setting up promotions, discounts, or campaigns on an ecommerce platform.
* An understanding of how ecommerce connects to sales, inventory, and customer service, not just marketing.
* Organized and dependable with recurring daily work, while juggling projects and deadlines.
* Comfortable working with people across departments, including those who don't work in ecommerce.

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Shopify experience, including apps, collections, and discount setup.
* NetSuite experience, especially item records and saved searches.
* B2B, wholesale, or multi-channel ecommerce experience.
* Experience with seasonal, perishable, or fast-changing inventory.
* Familiarity with Google Analytics or similar web analytics tools.
* Basic SEO knowledge and experience with bulk product imports (CSV).conversation.
